questions.question: In a game for 24 groups, the average number of children was 16. When 1 more group of children joined the game, the average number of children became 18. The boys and girls who joined were in the ratio 5 : 6. If there were 220 boys at 1st, how many more boys than girls were there in the end?
questions.hint: Find the totals for 24 and 25 groups. Split the new group's children into 5 boy-units and 6 girl-units, then compare the final totals.

en.strategy: Use the two averages to find the 66 children in the new group, then use its 5 : 6 ratio.

steps.title: Find the new group
steps.text: The first 24 groups had 24 × 16 = 384 children. All 25 groups had 25 × 18 = 450 children, so the group that joined had 450 − 384 = 66 children.

steps.title: Split the new group
steps.text: The 5 : 6 ratio has 11 parts, so each part is 66 ÷ 11 = 6. The new group had 5 × 6 = 30 boys and 6 × 6 = 36 girls.

steps.title: Compare the final numbers
steps.text: There were 220 boys at first, so there were 220 + 30 = 250 boys at the end. The original 384 children included 384 − 220 = 164 girls; 164 + 36 = 200 girls at the end. The difference is 250 − 200 = 50.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用2个平均数求出新加入的66人，再按5 : 6分配男女生人数。

steps.title: 按比例分配
steps.text: 5 : 6总共是11份，每份是66 ÷ 11 = 6人。因此新组有5 × 6 = 30名男生和6 × 6 = 36名女生。

questions.questionZh: 在一场有24个小组参加的比赛中，平均每组有16名儿童。又有1个儿童小组加入比赛后，平均每组儿童人数变为18。新加入的男生和女生人数之比为5 : 6。若1st时有220名男生，最后男生比女生多多少名？
questions.hintZh: 分别求24个小组和25个小组的总人数。把新小组的儿童按5个男生单位和6个女生单位分开，再比较最后的总人数。

questions.question: 1/2 of a number is 90 more than 1/5 of the same number. What is the number?
questions.hint: Represent the whole number using a denominator of 10. The difference between 1/2 and 1/5 is the part worth 90.

en.strategy: Compare the two fractions of the same number.

steps.title: Find the whole number
steps.text: If 3/10 is 90, then 1/10 is 90 ÷ 3 = 30. Therefore the whole number is 10 × 30 = 300.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较同样的数的2个分数部分。

questions.questionZh: 一个数的1/2比同一个数的1/5多90。这个数是多少？
questions.hintZh: 用分母为10表示整个数。1/2和1/5之间的差所代表的部分是90。

questions.question: A florist arranges some orchids in bouquets of 20 and some roses in bouquets of 10. She sells each orchid bouquet for $25 and each rose bouquet for $30. She earns $390 altogether. If she sells 4 times as many orchid bouquets as rose bouquets, how many flowers does she sell altogether?
questions.hint: Make 1 set from 4 orchid bouquets and 1 rose bouquet. Find the money and number of flowers in each set.

en.strategy: Make one sales set of 4 orchid bouquets and 1 rose bouquet.

steps.title: Find the value of one set
Find how many sets were sold
steps.text: $390 ÷ $130 = 3 sets. Therefore 3 × 4 = 12 orchid bouquets and 3 × 1 = 3 rose bouquets were sold.

steps.title: Count the flowers
steps.text: The orchid bouquets contain 12 × 20 = 240 orchids. The rose bouquets contain 3 × 10 = 30 roses. Altogether, 240 + 30 = 270 flowers.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把4束兰花和1束玫瑰看成1组销售组合。

questions.questionZh: 一位花店老板把一些兰花每20枝扎成一束，把一些玫瑰每10枝扎成一束。每束兰花卖$25，每束玫瑰卖$30。她总共赚了$390。如果她卖出的兰花束数是玫瑰束数的4倍，她总共卖出了多少枝花？
questions.hintZh: 把4束兰花和1束玫瑰组成1组。求每组的收入和花的数量。

questions.question: Ken and Ivan had some sweets. After Ken gave away 5/7 of his sweets, he had 2/3 as many sweets as Ivan. Ivan then gave away 120 sweets and he had 1/4 as many sweets as Ken. How many sweets did each of them have at 1st?
questions.hint: Use the 1st condition to relate Ken's remaining 2 parts to Ivan's 3 parts. Then use Ivan's 120-sweet change and the 1:4 comparison.

en.strategy: Relate Ken's remaining sweets to Ivan's sweets, then use Ivan's 120-sweet loss.

steps.title: Set up the first comparison
steps.text: Ken kept 2/7 of his original sweets, and this was 2/3 as many as Ivan's amount. Thus Ken's remaining sweets : Ivan's sweets = 2 : 3.

steps.title: Use Ivan's later amount
steps.text: Let Ken's remaining amount be 4 units. Ivan's original amount is then 6 units. After Ivan gives away 120 sweets, he has 1 unit because he has 1/4 as many as Ken's 4 units. Therefore 5 units = 120, so 1 unit = 24.

steps.title: Work back to both starting amounts
steps.text: Ivan had 6 × 24 = 144 sweets. Ken had 4 × 24 = 96 sweets after giving away 5/7, which is 2/7 of his original amount. Ken originally had 96 × 7 ÷ 2 = 336 sweets.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先把Ken剩下的糖果和Ivan的糖果建立比例，再利用Ivan送出120颗糖果。

steps.title: 建立第1个比例
steps.text: Ken剩下原来糖果的2/7，而这相当于Ivan糖果的2/3。因此Ken剩下的糖果 : Ivan原有的糖果 = 2 : 3。

steps.title: 利用Ivan后来剩下的数量
steps.text: 把Ken剩下的糖果设为4份，Ivan原有的是6份。Ivan送出120颗后只剩1份，因为这时Ivan的糖果是Ken的4份的1/4。于是5份 = 120，1份 = 24。

steps.title: 倒推开始时的数量
steps.text: Ivan原有6 × 24 = 144颗糖果。Ken送出后有4 × 24 = 96颗，这占原有数量的2/7，所以Ken原有96 × 7 ÷ 2 = 336颗糖果。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: Ivan原有144颗糖果；Ken原有336颗糖果。

questions.questionZh: Ken和Ivan各有一些糖果。Ken送出自己糖果的5/7后，他的糖果数量是Ivan的2/3。随后Ivan送出120颗糖果，他的糖果数量变为Ken的1/4。两人1st时各有多少颗糖果？
questions.hintZh: 利用第1个条件，将Ken剩下的2份与Ivan的3份建立关系。再利用Ivan送出的120颗糖果和1:4的比较关系。

questions.question: Hotel A and Hotel B had 6500 guests altogether. After 3/4 of the guests in Hotel A and 3/5 of the guests in Hotel B checked out, there were 260 more guests in Hotel B than in Hotel A. How many guests did Hotel A have at 1st?
questions.hint: Model the remaining guests as 1/4 of Hotel A and 2/5 of Hotel B. Use the 260 difference, then the original total.

en.strategy: Use the fractions that remained in the two hotels and the total of 6500 guests.

steps.title: Write the remaining amounts
steps.text: Hotel A kept 1/4 of its guests. Hotel B kept 2/5 of its guests.

steps.title: Use the total and difference
steps.text: Let Hotel A originally have A guests, so Hotel B has 6500 − A guests. The remaining difference is 2/5(6500 − A) − 1/4A = 260.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用2家酒店离开后剩下的分数，以及总人数6500来列式。

steps.title: 写出剩余人数
steps.text: Hotel A剩下原来人数的1/4，Hotel B剩下原来人数的2/5。

steps.title: 利用总数和人数差
steps.text: 设Hotel A原有A人，则Hotel B原有6500 − A人。剩余人数差为2/5(6500 − A) − 1/4A = 260。

questions.questionZh: 酒店A和酒店B共有6500名住客。酒店A的3/4住客和酒店B的3/5住客退房后，酒店B比酒店A多260名住客。酒店A在1st时有多少名住客？
questions.hintZh: 把剩余住客人数表示为酒店A原人数的1/4和酒店B原人数的2/5。利用260的人数差，再利用原来的总人数。

questions.question: There were 900 sweets in 3 boxes, A, B and C. 18 sweets were transferred from A to B and 5 sweets were transferred from B to C. Then 1/3 of the sweets in C were transferred to A. There was an equal number of sweets in all 3 boxes. How many sweets were there in each box at 1st?
questions.answer: Box A: 168 sweets; Box B: 287 sweets; Box C: 445 sweets
questions.hint: Start with the equal final amount in each box. Reverse the transfer from C to A, then reverse the 2 earlier transfers.

en.strategy: Work backwards from the equal final number in all 3 boxes.

steps.title: Find the final amount in each box
steps.text: The total stays 900 sweets, and the 3 final box amounts are equal. Each box therefore ends with 900 ÷ 3 = 300 sweets.

steps.title: Reverse the transfer from C to A
steps.text: Before 1/3 of C was transferred, C had 300 × 3/2 = 450 sweets and A had 300 − 150 = 150 sweets. Box B still had 300 sweets.

steps.title: Reverse the earlier transfers
steps.text: Before 5 sweets moved from B to C, B had 305 and C had 445. Before 18 sweets moved from A to B, A had 168 and B had 287. So the starting amounts were A = 168, B = 287, C = 445.

en.answerCheck: Box A: 168 sweets; Box B: 287 sweets; Box C: 445 sweets

zh-Hans.strategy: 从3个盒子最后糖果数相等的状态倒推。

steps.title: 求每个盒子最后的数量
steps.text: 糖果总数仍是900，最后3个盒子数量相等，所以每盒有900 ÷ 3 = 300颗糖果。

steps.title: 倒推C到A的转移
steps.text: 转移前，C的1/3被转走，故C原来有300 × 3/2 = 450颗；A收到150颗前有300 − 150 = 150颗。B仍有300颗。

steps.title: 倒推前2次转移
steps.text: B转5颗给C之前，B有305颗，C有445颗。A转18颗给B之前，A有168颗，B有287颗。因此开始时A有168颗，B有287颗，C有445颗。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 开始时A盒有168颗糖果；B盒有287颗糖果；C盒有445颗糖果。

questions.questionZh: A、B和C这3个盒子里共有900颗糖果。18颗糖果从A转到B，5颗糖果从B转到C。然后，C中糖果的1/3转到A。最后3个盒子里的糖果数量相等。各盒子在1st时各有多少颗糖果？
questions.hintZh: 从每个盒子最后相等的糖果数量开始倒推。先倒推从C转到A的糖果，再倒推前面2次转移。

questions.question: Some boys and girls took part in a competition. 2/5 of the competitors were boys. 1/3 of the boys were disqualified. If there were 135 competitors at 1st, how many more girls than boys were left?
questions.hint: Find the original boys and girls. Only 2/3 of the boys remain; compare that with the unchanged number of girls.

en.strategy: Find the original boys and girls, then remove 1/3 of the boys.

steps.title: Find the original groups
steps.text: Boys were 2/5 of 135, so there were 135 × 2/5 = 54 boys. Girls were 135 − 54 = 81.

steps.title: Find the boys left
steps.text: After 1/3 of the boys were disqualified, 2/3 remained: 54 × 2/3 = 36 boys.

steps.title: Compare the groups
steps.text: The 81 girls were unchanged. The difference is 81 − 36 = 45.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求出原来的男生和女生人数，再减去1/3的男生。

steps.title: 求剩下的男生
steps.text: 1/3男生被取消资格后，剩下2/3：54 × 2/3 = 36名男生。

steps.title: 比较人数
steps.text: 81名女生没有改变，人数差为81 − 36 = 45。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 剩下的女生比男生多45人。

questions.questionZh: 一些男生和女生参加了一场比赛。参赛者中有2/5是男生。男生中有1/3被取消资格。如果1st时有135名参赛者，最后女生比男生多多少名？
questions.hintZh: 先求原来男生和女生的人数。只有男生的2/3留下来；把这个数与未改变的女生人数比较。

questions.question: Mrs Walker had some lemons. She put 1/2 of the lemons equally into 5 bags and the other 1/2 equally into 6 containers. There were 63 lemons in 1 bag and 3 containers altogether. How many lemons did Mrs Walker have?
questions.hint: Express the lemons in 1 bag and 3 containers as fractions of the total, then use their combined 63 lemons.

en.strategy: Express 1 bag and 3 containers as fractions of all the lemons.

steps.title: Write each portion as a fraction
steps.text: Half the lemons are shared among 5 bags, so 1 bag holds 1/2 ÷ 5 = 1/10 of all the lemons. The other half is shared among 6 containers, so 3 containers hold 3 × (1/2 ÷ 6) = 1/4 of all the lemons.

steps.title: Find the total
steps.text: One bag and 3 containers hold 1/10 + 1/4 = 7/20 of the lemons, and this is 63. The total is 63 × 20 ÷ 7 = 180 lemons.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把1个袋子和3个容器里的柠檬都表示成总数的分数。

steps.title: 写出每部分的分数
steps.text: 1/2的柠檬平均放入5个袋子，所以1个袋子有总数的1/2 ÷ 5 = 1/10。另1/2平均放入6个容器，3个容器有3 × (1/2 ÷ 6) = 1/4。

steps.title: 求总数
steps.text: 1个袋子和3个容器共有1/10 + 1/4 = 7/20的柠檬，这等于63个。总数是63 × 20 ÷ 7 = 180个柠檬。

questions.questionZh: Walker太太有一些柠檬。她将1/2的柠檬平均放入5个袋子，将另外1/2的柠檬平均放入6个容器。1个袋子和3个容器中总共有63个柠檬。Walker太太有多少个柠檬？
questions.hintZh: 把1个袋子和3个容器中的柠檬表示为总数的分数，再利用它们合起来的63个柠檬。

questions.question: The ratio of the number of biscuits that Andy and Betty had was 2 : 5. After Andy bought 24 more biscuits, the ratio became 16 : 10. If there were 6 biscuits in a pack, how many packs of biscuits would Betty have to buy so that they would have the same number of biscuits in the end?
questions.hint: Compare the 2 ratios using the 24 extra biscuits to find Betty's amount. Then find how many more biscuits Betty needs and convert to packs.

en.strategy: Use the two ratios and Andy's 24 extra biscuits to find both current amounts.

steps.title: Represent the first ratio
steps.text: Let Andy and Betty originally have 2x and 5x biscuits.

steps.title: Use the new ratio
steps.text: After Andy buys 24, (2x + 24) : 5x = 16 : 10 = 8 : 5. Thus 5(2x + 24) = 8(5x), giving 10x + 120 = 40x and x = 4.

steps.title: Find Betty's packs
steps.text: Andy then has 2 × 4 + 24 = 32 biscuits, while Betty has 5 × 4 = 20. Betty needs 32 − 20 = 12 more biscuits, or 12 ÷ 6 = 2 packs.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用2个比例和Andy多买的24块饼干，求出2人当前的数量。

steps.title: 表示原来的比例
steps.text: 设Andy和Betty原来分别有2x和5x块饼干。

steps.title: 求Betty要买的包数
steps.text: Andy这时有2 × 4 + 24 = 32块，Betty有5 × 4 = 20块。Betty还需要32 − 20 = 12块，即12 ÷ 6 = 2包。

questions.questionZh: Andy和Betty的饼干数量之比是2 : 5。Andy又买了24块饼干后，这个比变为16 : 10。如果每包有6块饼干，Betty还要买多少包饼干，最后两人的饼干数量才会相同？
questions.hintZh: 利用24块额外的饼干比较这2个比，求出Betty的饼干数量。然后求Betty还需要多少块饼干，并换算成包数。

questions.question: Megan and Olivia had some money. They made a donation of $100 together. Megan donated 1/5 of her money. After donating $24, Olivia found that she had $32 more than Megan. What was the sum of money both of them had at 1st?
questions.hint: Olivia donated $24, so find Megan's donation from the $100 total. Use Megan's 1/5 donation to model the money she had left.

en.strategy: Find Megan's donation from the $100 total, then work back from the $32 difference.

steps.title: Find both donations
steps.text: Olivia donated $24, so Megan donated $100 − $24 = $76. This $76 was 1/5 of Megan's original money.

steps.title: Find Megan's amount left
steps.text: Megan originally had $76 × 5 = $380. After donating $76, she had $380 − $76 = $304 left.

steps.title: Find Olivia's original amount
steps.text: Olivia had $32 more than Megan after donating, so she had $304 + $32 = $336 left. Adding back her $24 donation gives $360. The starting total was $380 + $360 = $740.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由总捐款$100求Megan的捐款，再从$32的差额倒推。

steps.title: 求2人的捐款
steps.text: Olivia捐了$24，所以Megan捐了$100 − $24 = $76。这$76是Megan原有钱数的1/5。

steps.title: 求Olivia原有的钱和总数
steps.text: Olivia捐款后比Megan多$32，所以她剩下$304 + $32 = $336。加回捐出的$24，Olivia原有$360。开始时总数为$380 + $360 = $740。

questions.questionZh: Megan和Olivia有一些钱。两人一起捐了$100。Megan捐出了自己钱数的1/5。Olivia捐出$24后，发现自己比Megan多$32。两人在1st时共有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: Olivia捐出了$24，因此可由总数$100求出Megan的捐款。利用Megan捐出1/5的钱来表示她剩下的钱。

questions.question: Mrs Benjamin baked some butter cookies and chocolate chip cookies in the ratio 7 : 3. After giving away 24 butter cookies, the ratio of butter cookies to chocolate chip cookies was 11 : 6. She then packed the remaining cookies into bags of 4 without mixing them. How many bags of cookies of each type did she have?
questions.answer: 22 bags of butter cookies; 12 bags of chocolate chip cookies
questions.hint: Make the chocolate-chip parts in both ratios equal. The drop in butter-cookie parts represents the 24 cookies given away.

en.strategy: Match the chocolate-chip parts in the two ratios, then use the 24 butter cookies given away.

steps.title: Set up matching ratios
steps.text: The original ratio is 7 : 3. The final ratio is 11 : 6. Multiply the original ratio by 2 to make 6 chocolate-chip parts: original butter : chocolate chip = 14 : 6.

steps.title: Find the size of one part
steps.text: Butter cookies changed from 14 parts to 11 parts, a decrease of 3 parts. This decrease was 24 cookies, so 1 part = 24 ÷ 3 = 8 cookies.

steps.title: Pack the remaining cookies
steps.text: The remaining butter cookies are 11 × 8 = 88, giving 88 ÷ 4 = 22 bags. The chocolate-chip cookies are 6 × 8 = 48, giving 48 ÷ 4 = 12 bags.

en.answerCheck: 22 bags of butter cookies; 12 bags of chocolate chip cookies

zh-Hans.strategy: 先让2个比例中的巧克力曲奇份数相同，再利用送出的24块黄油曲奇。

steps.title: 配成相同的比例份数
steps.text: 原来的比例是7 : 3，后来的比例是11 : 6。把原比例乘2，得到黄油曲奇 : 巧克力曲奇 = 14 : 6。

steps.title: 求每份数量
steps.text: 黄油曲奇从14份变成11份，少了3份；这3份就是送出的24块。因此1份 = 24 ÷ 3 = 8块。

steps.title: 把剩下的曲奇装袋
steps.text: 剩下的黄油曲奇有11 × 8 = 88块，可装88 ÷ 4 = 22袋。巧克力曲奇有6 × 8 = 48块，可装48 ÷ 4 = 12袋。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 有22袋黄油曲奇和12袋巧克力曲奇。

questions.questionZh: Benjamin太太烤了一些黄油曲奇和巧克力碎片曲奇，数量之比为7 : 3。送出24块黄油曲奇后，黄油曲奇与巧克力碎片曲奇的数量之比变为11 : 6。随后，她把剩下的曲奇分开装入每袋4块的袋子中。每种曲奇各有多少袋？
questions.hintZh: 使两个比中巧克力碎片曲奇的份数相等。黄油曲奇份数减少的部分代表送出的24块曲奇。

questions.question: There were some red, yellow and blue toy cars in a box. 3/8 of the toy cars were red and 26 were blue. The rest were yellow. If there were 12 fewer yellow toy cars than blue toy cars, how many red toy cars were there?
questions.hint: Use the 12-car difference to find the yellow cars. Then combine yellow and blue cars and relate that total to the 5/8 that are not red.

en.strategy: Use the 12-car difference to find yellow cars, then relate yellow plus blue to 5/8 of the total.

steps.title: Find the yellow cars
steps.text: There are 26 blue cars and 12 fewer yellow cars, so yellow cars = 26 − 12 = 14.

steps.title: Find the total
steps.text: Yellow and blue cars total 14 + 26 = 40. They are the 5/8 that are not red, so 5/8 of the total is 40.

steps.title: Find the red cars
steps.text: The total is 40 × 8 ÷ 5 = 64. Red cars are 3/8 of 64, which is 64 × 3/8 = 24.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先利用12辆的差求黄色玩具车，再把黄车和蓝车看作总数的5/8。

steps.title: 求黄色玩具车数量
steps.text: 蓝色有26辆，黄色比蓝色少12辆，所以黄色有26 − 12 = 14辆。

steps.title: 求总数
steps.text: 黄色和蓝色共有14 + 26 = 40辆，这正是非红色的5/8，所以总数的5/8 = 40。

questions.questionZh: 一个盒子里有一些红色、黄色和蓝色玩具车。玩具车中有3/8是红色，26辆是蓝色，其余是黄色。如果黄色玩具车比蓝色玩具车少12辆，红色玩具车有多少辆？
questions.hintZh: 利用12辆的差求出黄色玩具车的数量。然后将黄色和蓝色玩具车合起来，并把这个总数与非红色玩具车所占的5/8联系起来。

questions.question: There were 900 oranges and apples in a box. When 7/9 of the oranges and 2/3 of the apples were taken out, there was an equal number of oranges and apples left. How many more oranges than apples were there at 1st?
questions.hint: The remaining oranges are 2/9 of the original oranges and the remaining apples are 1/3 of the original apples. Make these equal.

en.strategy: Make the equal remaining oranges and apples into a ratio of their original amounts.

steps.title: Write the fractions remaining
steps.text: After 7/9 of the oranges are taken out, 2/9 remain. After 2/3 of the apples are taken out, 1/3 remain.

steps.title: Find the original ratio
steps.text: Because the remaining amounts are equal, 2/9 of the oranges = 1/3 of the apples. This gives oranges : apples = 3 : 2.

steps.title: Use the total
steps.text: The 3 + 2 = 5 parts equal 900, so 1 part = 180. Oranges = 3 × 180 = 540 and apples = 2 × 180 = 360. The difference is 540 − 360 = 180.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把剩下的橙子和苹果数量相等，转化为原来数量的比例。

steps.title: 写出剩下的分数
steps.text: 取出橙子的7/9后，剩下2/9。取出苹果的2/3后，剩下1/3。

steps.title: 求原来数量的比例
steps.text: 剩下的数量相等，所以橙子原数的2/9 = 苹果原数的1/3。因此橙子 : 苹果 = 3 : 2。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 开始时橙子比苹果多180个。

questions.questionZh: 一个盒子里共有900个橙子和苹果。取出橙子的7/9和苹果的2/3后，剩下的橙子和苹果数量相等。1st时橙子比苹果多多少个？
questions.hintZh: 剩下的橙子是原来橙子的2/9，剩下的苹果是原来苹果的1/3。令这两个数量相等。

questions.question: There were 48 entries from Primary 1 and Primary 2 in a storytelling competition. The rest were from Primary 3. If 30 entries were not from Primary 1 and 28 entries were not from Primary 2, how many entries were there altogether?
questions.hint: Let the Primary 3 entries be the unknown group. Add the 2 statements about entries not from Primary 1 and not from Primary 2, then account for the Primary 3 entries counted 2 times.

en.strategy: Add the two ‘not from’ statements and account for the Primary 3 entries counted twice.

steps.title: Name the three groups
steps.text: Let the numbers from Primary 1, Primary 2, and Primary 3 be P1, P2, and P3. We know P1 + P2 = 48.

steps.title: Add the two complementary counts
steps.text: Not from Primary 1 means P2 + P3 = 30. Not from Primary 2 means P1 + P3 = 28. Adding gives P1 + P2 + 2P3 = 58.

steps.title: Find the total
steps.text: Since P1 + P2 = 48, we get 48 + 2P3 = 58, so P3 = 5. The total is 48 + 5 = 53 entries.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把2个“不是来自”的人数相加，并注意Primary 3被计算了2次。

steps.title: 设3个年级的人数
steps.text: 设Primary 1、Primary 2和Primary 3的参赛作品数分别为P1、P2、P3。已知P1 + P2 = 48。

steps.title: 相加2个补集人数
steps.text: 不是Primary 1的有P2 + P3 = 30；不是Primary 2的有P1 + P3 = 28。相加得P1 + P2 + 2P3 = 58。

questions.questionZh: 讲故事比赛中，来自小学1年级和小学2年级的参赛作品共有48个，其余来自小学3年级。如果有30个作品不是来自小学1年级，28个作品不是来自小学2年级，那么总共有多少个参赛作品？
questions.hintZh: 把小学3年级的参赛作品数设为未知数。将“不是来自小学1年级”和“不是来自小学2年级”的2个数量相加，再考虑小学3年级的作品被计算了2次。

questions.question: In a kindergarten, 12% of the students are Malays and the rest are Chinese. 50% of the Chinese and 12.5% of the Malays are boys. There are 912 more Chinese than Malay students. How many girls are there in the kindergarten?
questions.hint: The Chinese–Malay difference is 76% of the kindergarten. Find each group, then calculate the girls in each group.

en.strategy: Use the 76% difference to find the kindergarten total, then calculate girls in both groups.

steps.title: Find the total number of students
steps.text: Malays are 12% and Chinese students are 88%, so the difference is 88% − 12% = 76%. Since 76% is 912, the total is 912 ÷ 0.76 = 1200 students.

steps.title: Find each group and its girls
steps.text: There are 1200 × 12% = 144 Malays and 1200 × 88% = 1056 Chinese. Malay boys are 144 × 12.5% = 18, so Malay girls are 144 − 18 = 126. Chinese boys are 1056 × 50% = 528, so Chinese girls are 528.

steps.title: Add the girls
steps.text: The total number of girls is 126 + 528 = 654.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用76%的中马学生人数差求全园总人数，再分别计算女生人数。

questions.questionZh: 一所幼儿园中，学生的12%是马来人，其余是华人。华人中有50%是男生，马来人中有12.5%是男生。华人学生比马来学生多912人。幼儿园里有多少名女生？
questions.hintZh: 华人与马来学生的人数差占幼儿园学生总数的76%。先求每一组的人数，再计算每一组的女生人数。

questions.question: The ratio of oranges to papayas in a basket is 3 : 5. After 1/4 of the oranges and 1/2 of the papayas are eaten, there are 16 more papayas than oranges. How many fruit of each type are there in the basket at 1st?
questions.hint: Scale the 3:5 ratio so the remaining fractions, 3/4 and 1/2, give whole comparable units. Use the 16-fruit difference.

en.strategy: Use the 3 : 5 starting ratio and compare the fractions remaining.

steps.title: Represent the original amounts
steps.text: Let oranges = 3x and papayas = 5x.

steps.title: Find the amounts left
steps.text: After 1/4 of the oranges are eaten, 3/4 remain: 3x × 3/4 = 9x/4. After 1/2 of the papayas are eaten, 5x/2 remain.

steps.title: Use the 16-fruit difference
steps.text: The difference is 5x/2 − 9x/4 = x/4 = 16, so x = 64. Therefore there were 3 × 64 = 192 oranges and 5 × 64 = 320 papayas at first.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用开始时的3 : 5比例，并比较吃掉后剩下的分数。

steps.title: 表示原来的数量
steps.text: 设橙子有3x个，木瓜有5x个。

steps.title: 求剩余数量
steps.text: 吃掉橙子的1/4后剩下3/4，即3x × 3/4 = 9x/4。吃掉木瓜的1/2后剩下5x/2。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 开始时有192个橙子和320个木瓜。

questions.questionZh: 一个篮子里橙子与木瓜的数量之比为3 : 5。吃掉橙子的1/4和木瓜的1/2后，木瓜比橙子多16个。篮子在1st时每种水果各有多少个？
questions.hintZh: 把3:5的比放大，使剩下的分数3/4和1/2能得到可比较的整数单位。利用16个水果的差。

questions.question: Terence and Cynthia had some balloons in the ratio 5 : 9. When 15 of Terence's balloons burst, the ratio of Terence's to Cynthia's balloons was 10 : 27. How many balloons did each of them have at 1st?
questions.hint: Make Cynthia's 9 parts and 27 parts comparable. The difference in Terence's matching parts is the 15 balloons that burst.

en.strategy: Scale the two ratios to the same Cynthia amount, then use Terence's 15 burst balloons.

steps.title: Represent the first ratio
steps.text: Let Terence and Cynthia initially have 5x and 9x balloons.

steps.title: Use the ratio after the loss
steps.text: After 15 of Terence's balloons burst, the ratio is 10 : 27. Scale the original 5 : 9 ratio by 3 to get 15 : 27. Terence's matching amount fell from 15 parts to 10 parts, or 5 parts.

steps.title: Find both starting amounts
steps.text: The 5 parts that Terence lost equal 15 balloons, so 1 part = 3 and x = 9. Terence originally had 5 × 9 = 45 balloons, and Cynthia had 9 × 9 = 81 balloons.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把2个比例中Cynthia的份数配成相同，再利用Terence爆掉的15个气球。

steps.title: 表示第1个比例
steps.text: 设Terence和Cynthia开始时分别有5x和9x个气球。

steps.title: 利用气球爆掉后的比例
steps.text: Terence少了15个后，比例是10 : 27。把原来的5 : 9乘3，得到15 : 27。Terence对应的份数从15份降到10份，少了5份。

steps.title: 求开始时的数量
steps.text: 这5份等于爆掉的15个气球，所以1份 = 3，x = 9。Terence原有5 × 9 = 45个气球，Cynthia原有9 × 9 = 81个气球。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: Terence开始时有45个气球；Cynthia开始时有81个气球。

questions.questionZh: Terence和Cynthia的气球数量之比为5 : 9。Terence有15个气球爆破后，Terence与Cynthia的气球数量之比变为10 : 27。两人在1st时各有多少个气球？
questions.hintZh: 使Cynthia的9份和27份可以比较。Terence对应份数的差就是爆破的15个气球。

questions.question: Mr Willis had some oranges and pears. 60% of them were oranges. 70% of the pears and 40% of the oranges were sold. 240 fruit were not sold. How many fruit did Mr Willis have at 1st?
questions.hint: Find what percentage of each fruit type remained, then combine those portions using the 60%:40% original split.

en.strategy: Work out the unsold percentage of each fruit, then combine the two parts of the original total.

steps.title: Find each unsold part
steps.text: Oranges are 60% of the fruit, and 40% of the oranges were sold, so 60% of the oranges remain. Pears are 40% of the fruit, and 70% were sold, so 30% of the pears remain.

steps.title: Express the 240 fruit as a percentage
steps.text: Unsold oranges are 60% × 60% = 36% of the original total. Unsold pears are 40% × 30% = 12% of the original total. Thus 36% + 12% = 48% equals 240 fruit.

steps.title: Find the original total
steps.text: 100% = 240 ÷ 48% = 500, so Mr Willis had 500 fruit at 1st.

en.answerCheck: Check: 60% of 500 is 300 oranges and 40% is 200 pears. The unsold fruit is 60% of 300 plus 30% of 200, or 180 + 60 = 240. Answer: 500 fruit.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求每种水果未卖出的百分比，再把它们合并为原来总数的一部分。

steps.title: 求各自剩余的部分
steps.text: 橙子占水果总数的60%，橙子的40%卖掉，所以橙子的60%剩下。梨占40%，梨的70%卖掉，所以梨的30%剩下。

steps.title: 把240个水果表示成百分比
求原来总数
steps.text: 100% = 240 ÷ 48% = 500，所以Willis先生在1st有500个水果。

questions.questionZh: 威利斯先生有一些橙子和梨。其中60%是橙子。梨的70%和橙子的40%被卖掉了。还有240个水果没有卖出。威利斯先生最初（1st）有多少个水果？
questions.hintZh: 求每种水果剩下的百分比，然后根据原先60%:40%的比例合并这些部分。

questions.question: Joel and Anson have some marbles in the ratio 7 : 5. If Joel gives Anson 36 marbles, Anson will have 2 times as many marbles as Joel. How many marbles do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Draw the 7:5 ratio, then move 36 marbles from Joel to Anson. Compare the final 1:2 ratio.

en.strategy: Use one ratio unit for the original 7:5 ratio and form an equation after the 36-marble transfer.

steps.title: Represent the original ratio
steps.text: Let Joel have 7 units and Anson have 5 units. If 1 unit is x marbles, they start with 7x and 5x marbles.

steps.title: Use the final comparison
steps.text: After Joel gives 36 marbles, Joel has 7x − 36 and Anson has 5x + 36. Anson then has 2 times Joel's amount, so 5x + 36 = 2(7x − 36).

steps.title: Solve and total
steps.text: 5x + 36 = 14x − 72, so 9x = 108 and x = 12. The total is (7 + 5) × 12 = 144 marbles.

en.answerCheck: Check: Joel starts with 84 and Anson with 60. After 36 are transferred, they have 48 and 96, and 96 is 2 times 48. Answer: 144 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把原来的7 : 5设为单位数，再根据转移36颗后的关系列式。

steps.title: 表示原来的比
steps.text: 设Joel有7个单位，Anson有5个单位，每个单位是x颗弹珠。原来分别有7x颗和5x颗。

steps.title: 使用最后的倍数关系
steps.text: Joel给出36颗后，Joel有7x − 36颗，Anson有5x + 36颗。Anson的数量是Joel的2倍，所以5x + 36 = 2(7x − 36)。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：开始时Joel有84颗，Anson有60颗。转移36颗后是48颗和96颗，96是48的2倍。答案：144颗弹珠。

questions.questionZh: 乔尔和安森有一些弹珠，数量比为7 : 5。如果乔尔给安森36颗弹珠，安森的弹珠数量将是乔尔的2倍。他们一共有多少颗弹珠？
questions.hintZh: 画出7:5的比例，然后将36颗弹珠从乔尔转给安森。比较最后的1:2比例。

questions.question: There were 750 shirts in a box. 20% were pink and 18% were green. The remaining shirts were either yellow or black. If there were 85 more black shirts than yellow shirts, what was the total number of black and green shirts in the box?
questions.hint: First remove the pink and green shirts. Split the remaining yellow-and-black total into 2 quantities with a difference of 85.

en.strategy: Find the known colour counts, then split the yellow-and-black remainder using its difference.

steps.title: Find pink and green shirts
steps.text: Pink shirts: 20% of 750 = 150. Green shirts: 18% of 750 = 135.

steps.title: Split yellow and black shirts
steps.text: Yellow and black shirts total 750 − 150 − 135 = 465. Since black is 85 more than yellow, black = (465 + 85) ÷ 2 = 275.

steps.title: Combine the requested colours
steps.text: Black and green shirts total 275 + 135 = 410.

en.answerCheck: Check: yellow shirts are 465 − 275 = 190, and 275 − 190 = 85. Answer: 410 black and green shirts.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求已知颜色的数量，再利用相差85把黄色和黑色的剩余数量分开。

questions.questionZh: 盒子里有750件衬衫。20%是粉红色，18%是绿色。其余的是黄色或黑色。如果黑色衬衫比黄色衬衫多85件，盒子里黑色和绿色衬衫一共有多少件？
questions.hintZh: 先扣除粉红色和绿色衬衫。将剩下的黄色和黑色衬衫总数分成2个数量，它们相差85件。

questions.question: There are some apples in 3 baskets, A, B and C. The ratio of the number of apples in A to B is 5 : 3. There are 112 apples in C. If the ratio of the total number of apples in A and B to the number of apples in C is 6 : 2, how many more apples are there in A than in B?
questions.hint: Use Basket C and the 6:2 ratio to find A + B. Then divide that total in the 5:3 ratio and compare the 2 baskets.

en.strategy: Use Basket C to find the combined amount in A and B, then divide it in the 5:3 ratio.

steps.title: Find A + B
steps.text: The ratio (A + B) : C is 6 : 2. Since C = 112 represents 2 parts, 1 part is 112 ÷ 2 = 56 apples. Therefore A + B = 6 × 56 = 336 apples.

steps.title: Split A and B
steps.text: A : B = 5 : 3, or 8 parts altogether. One part is 336 ÷ 8 = 42 apples. A has 5 × 42 = 210 and B has 3 × 42 = 126.

steps.title: Compare the baskets
steps.text: A has 210 − 126 = 84 more apples than B.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用篮子C求A和B的总数，再按5 : 3分配。

steps.title: 求A + B
steps.text: (A + B) : C = 6 : 2。C的112个苹果代表2份，所以1份是112 ÷ 2 = 56个苹果。因此A + B = 6 × 56 = 336个苹果。

questions.questionZh: 3个篮子A、B和C中有一些苹果。A中苹果数量与B中苹果数量之比为5 : 3。C中有112个苹果。如果A和B中苹果总数与C中苹果数量之比为6 : 2，A比B多多少个苹果？
questions.hintZh: 利用C篮中的苹果数量和6:2的比例求出A + B。然后按5:3分配该总数，再比较2个篮子。

questions.question: There were some red, blue and green rubber bands in a box. 2/5 of the rubber bands were red. There were 40 green rubber bands and 24 more blue rubber bands than red rubber bands. How many rubber bands were there altogether?
questions.hint: The blue and green rubber bands together make the 3/5 that are not red. Use the 24 difference and 40 green rubber bands to form that total.

en.strategy: Express the blue-and-green total as 3/5 of all bands and relate it to the red count.

steps.title: Describe the non-red bands
steps.text: Red bands are 2/5 of the total, so blue plus green bands are 3/5 of the total. Blue is 24 more than red, and green is 40.

steps.title: Set up the fraction equation
steps.text: Let the total be T. Then blue + green = (2/5 T + 24) + 40 = 2/5 T + 64. This equals 3/5 T.

steps.title: Find the total
steps.text: 3/5 T − 2/5 T = 64, so 1/5 T = 64 and T = 320 rubber bands.

en.answerCheck: Check: 2/5 of 320 = 128 red bands; blue = 128 + 24 = 152; and 128 + 152 + 40 = 320. Answer: 320 rubber bands.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把蓝色和绿色的总数表示为全部橡皮筋的3/5，并与红色数量建立关系。

steps.title: 表示非红色橡皮筋
steps.text: 红色占总数的2/5，所以蓝色加绿色占总数的3/5。蓝色比红色多24条，绿色有40条。

questions.questionZh: 盒子里有一些红色、蓝色和绿色橡皮筋。橡皮筋中有2/5是红色。绿色橡皮筋有40条，蓝色橡皮筋比红色橡皮筋多24条。总共有多少条橡皮筋？
questions.hintZh: 蓝色和绿色橡皮筋合起来构成总数中非红色的3/5。利用相差24条和40条绿色橡皮筋求出这个总数。

questions.question: Francis, Philip and Jamie had $0.20, $0.50 and $1 coins respectively. Francis had 5 times as many coins as Jamie. Philip had 1/2 the number of coins that Jamie had. If Philip had 27 fewer coins than Francis, how much money did they have altogether?
questions.hint: Express the 3 coin counts in a common ratio. The difference between Francis and Philip is 27 coins; then apply each coin value.

en.strategy: Use Jamie's coin count as one variable, then apply the three different coin values.

steps.title: Relate the coin counts
steps.text: Let Jamie have x coins. Francis has 5x coins and Philip has 1/2 x coins. Their difference is 5x − 1/2x = 27.

steps.title: Find each count
steps.text: 9/2x = 27, so x = 6. Jamie has 6 coins, Francis has 30 coins, and Philip has 3 coins.

steps.title: Find the money total
steps.text: Francis has 30 × $0.20 = $6.00; Philip has 3 × $0.50 = $1.50; Jamie has 6 × $1 = $6.00. Total = $13.50.

en.answerCheck: Check: Francis has 30 coins and Philip has 3, a difference of 27 coins. Their values total $6.00 + $1.50 + $6.00 = $13.50. Answer: $13.50.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用Jamie的硬币数量设未知数，再分别乘以3种硬币面值。

steps.title: 建立硬币数量关系
steps.text: 设Jamie有x枚硬币。Francis有5x枚，Philip有1/2 x枚。他们相差5x − 1/2x = 27枚。

steps.title: 求各人的硬币数
steps.text: 9/2x = 27，所以x = 6。Jamie有6枚，Francis有30枚，Philip有3枚。

questions.questionZh: 弗朗西斯、菲利普和杰米分别拥有面值为$0.20、$0.50和$1的硬币。弗朗西斯的硬币数量是杰米的5倍。菲利普的硬币数量是杰米的1/2。菲利普的硬币比弗朗西斯少27枚。他们总共有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 把3人的硬币数量表示为一个共同的比。弗朗西斯和菲利普相差27枚硬币；然后应用每种硬币的面值。

questions.question: There were some apple pies and lemon pies in 2 boxes, A and B. Box A had 40% of the total number of pies. Box B had 12 apple pies. If 75% of the pies in Box B were lemon pies, what was the total number of pies in both boxes?
questions.hint: The apple pies are the 25% of Box B that are not lemon pies. Find Box B, then use its 60% share of the total.

en.strategy: Use the 12 apple pies as the 25% non-lemon part of Box B, then scale Box B to the total.

steps.title: Find Box B
steps.text: If 75% of Box B is lemon pie, the remaining 25% is apple pie. Thus 25% of Box B = 12, so Box B has 12 ÷ 25% = 48 pies.

steps.title: Use Box B's share
steps.text: Box A has 40% of all pies, so Box B has the remaining 60%. Therefore 60% of the total is 48 pies.

steps.title: Find all pies
steps.text: The total is 48 ÷ 60% = 80 pies.

en.answerCheck: Check: 40% of 80 is 32 pies in A and 60% is 48 pies in B. Of the 48 pies in B, 25% is 12 apple pies. Answer: 80 pies.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把盒子B中的12个苹果派看作非柠檬派的25%，再把盒子B扩大到总数。

steps.title: 求盒子B的数量
steps.text: 盒子B中75%是柠檬派，剩下25%是苹果派。因此盒子B的25% = 12，盒子B有12 ÷ 25% = 48个派。

steps.title: 利用盒子B所占的比例
steps.text: 盒子A占全部派的40%，所以盒子B占剩下的60%。因此总数的60%是48个派。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：80的40% = 32个派在A，60% = 48个派在B。B中的48个派有25%即12个苹果派。答案：80个派。

questions.questionZh: 2个盒子A和B里有一些苹果派和柠檬派。盒子A有派总数的40%。盒子B有12个苹果派。如果盒子B中75%的派是柠檬派，盒子里一共有多少个派？
questions.hintZh: 苹果派占盒子B中非柠檬派的25%。先求盒子B的数量，再利用它占总数的60%。

questions.question: Juliana and Patrick had some marbles. If Juliana gave Patrick 20 marbles, both would have an equal number of marbles. If Patrick gave Juliana 20 marbles, Juliana would have 3 times as many marbles as Patrick. Find the number of marbles that each had at 1st.
questions.hint: The 1st transfer shows the original difference. Use the reversed transfer to form the 3:1 comparison, then solve with 20-marble units.

en.strategy: Turn the first transfer into the original difference, then use the second transfer's 3:1 relationship.

steps.title: Find the original difference
steps.text: If Juliana gives Patrick 20 marbles and they become equal, Juliana originally has 40 more marbles than Patrick: giving 20 away lowers her amount by 20 and raises Patrick's by 20.

steps.title: Use the reversed transfer
steps.text: Let Patrick initially have P marbles, so Juliana has P + 40. If Patrick gives Juliana 20, the new amounts are P − 20 and P + 60. Juliana then has 3 times Patrick's amount.

steps.title: Solve the comparison
steps.text: P + 60 = 3(P − 20), so P + 60 = 3P − 60, 2P = 120, and P = 60. Juliana has 60 + 40 = 100 marbles.

en.answerCheck: Check: 100 − 20 = 60 + 20 = 80. In the other transfer, 100 + 20 = 120 and 60 − 20 = 40, and 120 is 3 times 40. Answer: Juliana: 100 marbles; Patrick: 60 marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由第1次转移求原来的差，再用第2次转移后的3 : 1关系。

steps.title: 求原来的差
steps.text: Juliana给Patrick 20颗后两人相等，说明Juliana原来比Patrick多40颗：她减少20颗，而Patrick增加20颗。

steps.title: 使用反向转移
steps.text: 设Patrick原来有P颗，那么Juliana有P + 40颗。Patrick给Juliana 20颗后，数量是P − 20颗和P + 60颗，Juliana的数量是Patrick的3倍。

questions.questionZh: 朱莉安娜和帕特里克有一些弹珠。如果朱莉安娜给帕特里克20颗弹珠，两人的弹珠数量就会相等。如果帕特里克给朱莉安娜20颗弹珠，朱莉安娜的弹珠数量将是帕特里克的3倍。求他们最初（1st）各有多少颗弹珠。
questions.hintZh: 第1次转移表明原来相差多少。利用反向转移建立3:1的比较关系，再以20颗弹珠为单位求解。

questions.question: On Sunday, Mrs Campbell baked some cookies and put all of them into a box. She then took out 2/5 of them. Of these, 15 were given away and the remaining 23 were eaten. On Monday, she baked another tray of cookies and put 3/4 of them into the same box. There were then 183 cookies in the box altogether. How many cookies did Mrs Campbell bake on Monday?
questions.hint: The 15 given away and 23 eaten make the 2/5 removed on Sunday. Find what stayed in the box, then find the Monday amount from its 3/4 portion.

en.strategy: Use the 38 cookies removed on Sunday to find the Sunday batch, then find Monday's batch from the amount added to the box.

steps.title: Find Sunday's original batch
steps.text: The cookies taken out on Sunday were 15 given away plus 23 eaten, or 38 cookies. This is 2/5 of Sunday's batch, so Sunday's batch was 38 ÷ 2/5 = 95 cookies.

steps.title: Find what was added on Monday
steps.text: After Sunday, 3/5 of 95 = 57 cookies remained in the box. The box later held 183 cookies, so Monday added 183 − 57 = 126 cookies.

steps.title: Find Monday's full batch
steps.text: The 126 cookies added were 3/4 of Monday's batch. Monday's batch was 126 ÷ 3/4 = 168 cookies.

en.answerCheck: Check: 2/5 of 95 is 38, leaving 57. Also, 3/4 of 168 is 126, and 57 + 126 = 183. Answer: 168 cookies.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用星期日取出的38块先求星期日的总数，再由放入盒子的数量求星期一烤的总数。

steps.title: 求星期日原来的数量
steps.text: 星期日取出的饼干是送人的15块加吃掉的23块，即38块。这是星期日总数的2/5，所以星期日烤了38 ÷ 2/5 = 95块。

steps.title: 求星期一放入盒子的数量
steps.text: 星期日后，盒中剩下95的3/5 = 57块。后来盒中有183块，所以星期一放入183 − 57 = 126块。

steps.title: 求星期一烤的总数
steps.text: 放入的126块是星期一总数的3/4。星期一烤了126 ÷ 3/4 = 168块饼干。

questions.questionZh: 星期日，坎贝尔太太烤了一些饼干，并把所有饼干放进一个盒子。随后她取出了其中的2/5。取出的饼干中，15块送人了，其余23块被吃掉了。星期一，她又烤了一盘饼干，并将其中的3/4放入同一个盒子。此时盒子里总共有183块饼干。坎贝尔太太星期一烤了多少块饼干？
questions.hintZh: 送人的15块和吃掉的23块构成星期日取出的2/5。求盒中留下的数量，再根据星期一放入的3/4求出星期一烤的总数。

questions.question: A bag of sweets was shared among Bob, Nancy, Lucy and Nicholas. Bob had 2 times as many sweets as Nancy. Lucy had 1/2 the total number of sweets that Bob and Nancy had. Nicholas had 90 sweets, which was 3 times as many sweets as Lucy had. How many sweets were there in the bag?
questions.hint: Use Nicholas's sweets to find Lucy's. Then let Nancy be 1 unit, Bob be 2 units, and match Lucy to 1/2 of their combined amount.

en.strategy: Use Nicholas's 90 sweets to find Lucy's amount, then find Bob and Nancy from their linked relationship.

steps.title: Find Lucy's sweets
steps.text: Nicholas has 90 sweets, which is 3 times Lucy's amount. Therefore Lucy has 90 ÷ 3 = 30 sweets.

steps.title: Find Bob and Nancy
steps.text: Lucy has 1/2 of Bob's and Nancy's combined sweets, so Bob + Nancy = 2 × 30 = 60. Bob has 2 times Nancy's sweets, so the 60 sweets are split in a 2:1 ratio.

steps.title: Add all four amounts
steps.text: Nancy has 20 sweets and Bob has 40 sweets. The total is 40 + 20 + 30 + 90 = 180 sweets.

en.answerCheck: Check: Bob's 40 is 2 times Nancy's 20, and Lucy's 30 is 1/2 of 40 + 20. Answer: 180 sweets.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由Nicholas的90颗糖果求Lucy的数量，再求Bob和Nancy的数量。

steps.title: 求Lucy的糖果数
steps.text: Nicholas有90颗糖果，是Lucy数量的3倍。因此Lucy有90 ÷ 3 = 30颗。

steps.title: 求Bob和Nancy的数量
steps.text: Lucy的30颗是Bob和Nancy总数的1/2，所以Bob + Nancy = 2 × 30 = 60颗。Bob的数量是Nancy的2倍，因此60颗按2 : 1分配。

steps.title: 相加4人的数量
steps.text: Nancy有20颗，Bob有40颗。总数是40 + 20 + 30 + 90 = 180颗糖果。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：Bob的40颗是Nancy的20颗的2倍，Lucy的30颗是40 + 20的一半。答案：180颗糖果。

questions.questionZh: 一袋糖果由鲍勃、南希、露西和尼古拉斯分得。鲍勃的糖果数量是南希的2倍。露西的糖果数量是鲍勃和南希糖果总数的1/2。尼古拉斯有90颗糖果，是露西糖果数量的3倍。这袋糖果共有多少颗？
questions.hintZh: 利用尼古拉斯的糖果数求出露西的糖果数。然后设南希为1个单位、鲍勃为2个单位，并使露西的数量对应于他们合计数量的1/2。

questions.question: Sandra, Ted and Justina had 377 coins altogether. Sandra gave Justina 15 coins and Ted received 13 coins from Justina. In the end, the ratio of Sandra's coins to Ted's coins was 4 : 3, and the ratio of Sandra's coins to Justina's coins was 3 : 2. How many coins did each have at 1st?
questions.answer: Sandra: 171 coins; Ted: 104 coins; Justina: 102 coins
questions.hint: Combine the 4:3 and 3:2 final ratios using a common Sandra value. Use the unchanged total of 377, then reverse both transfers.

en.strategy: Combine the two final ratios, use the unchanged total, then reverse the transfers.

steps.title: Combine the final ratios
steps.text: Sandra : Ted = 4 : 3 and Sandra : Justina = 3 : 2. Make Sandra 12 parts: the final ratio Sandra : Ted : Justina is 12 : 9 : 8.

steps.title: Find the final numbers
steps.text: There are 12 + 9 + 8 = 29 parts, and 377 ÷ 29 = 13 coins per part. Finally, Sandra has 156, Ted 117, and Justina 104 coins.

steps.title: Reverse both transfers
steps.text: Sandra gave away 15, so she began with 156 + 15 = 171. Ted received 13, so he began with 117 − 13 = 104. Justina received 15 then gave 13, so she began with 104 − 15 + 13 = 102.

en.answerCheck: Check: 171 + 104 + 102 = 377. After the transfers: Sandra 156, Ted 117, Justina 104, giving 156:117 = 4:3 and 156:104 = 3:2. Answer: Sandra: 171 coins; Ted: 104 coins; Justina: 102 coins.

zh-Hans.strategy: 合并最后的两个比，利用不变的总数，再倒推转移。

steps.title: 合并最后的比
steps.text: Sandra : Ted = 4 : 3，Sandra : Justina = 3 : 2。把Sandra化为12份，最后Sandra : Ted : Justina = 12 : 9 : 8。

steps.title: 求最后的数量
steps.text: 总份数是12 + 9 + 8 = 29份，每份是377 ÷ 29 = 13枚。最后Sandra有156枚，Ted有117枚，Justina有104枚。

steps.title: 倒推两次转移
steps.text: Sandra给出15枚，所以开始有156 + 15 = 171枚。Ted得到13枚，所以开始有117 − 13 = 104枚。Justina先得到15枚再给出13枚，所以开始有104 − 15 + 13 = 102枚。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：171 + 104 + 102 = 377。转移后Sandra有156枚，Ted有117枚，Justina有104枚，156:117 = 4:3，156:104 = 3:2。答案：Sandra有171枚；Ted有104枚；Justina有102枚硬币。

questions.questionZh: 桑德拉、泰德和贾斯蒂娜一共有377枚硬币。桑德拉给了贾斯蒂娜15枚硬币，泰德从贾斯蒂娜那里得到了13枚硬币。最后，桑德拉与泰德的硬币数量之比为4 : 3，桑德拉与贾斯蒂娜的硬币数量之比为3 : 2。他们最初（1st）各有多少枚硬币？
questions.hintZh: 用桑德拉的共同数值合并最后的4:3和3:2比例。利用不变的总数377，再倒推这两次转移。

questions.question: A farm had some cows and goats. 1/5 of the cows and 3/11 of the goats were sold. There was an equal number of cows and goats left. If there were 704 cows and goats left, how many animals were on the farm at 1st?
questions.hint: Split the 704 remaining animals equally between cows and goats. Those equal amounts are 4/5 of the cows and 8/11 of the goats.

en.strategy: Because the remaining cows and goats are equal, split the 704 equally and reverse each fraction sold.

steps.title: Find each remaining group
steps.text: There are 704 animals left and equal numbers of cows and goats, so 704 ÷ 2 = 352 cows and 352 goats remain.

steps.title: Reverse the sales
steps.text: After selling 1/5 of the cows, 4/5 remain, so the original cows were 352 ÷ 4/5 = 440. After selling 3/11 of the goats, 8/11 remain, so the original goats were 352 ÷ 8/11 = 484.

steps.title: Find the original animal total
steps.text: The farm originally had 440 + 484 = 924 animals.

en.answerCheck: Check: 4/5 of 440 = 352 and 8/11 of 484 = 352; together 352 + 352 = 704. Answer: 924 animals.

zh-Hans.strategy: 剩下的奶牛和山羊数量相等，所以把704平均分开，再倒推卖出的分数。

steps.title: 求两类剩余数量
steps.text: 剩下704头动物，奶牛和山羊数量相等，所以各有704 ÷ 2 = 352头。

steps.title: 求原来动物总数
steps.text: 农场原来有440 + 484 = 924头动物。

questions.questionZh: 一个农场有一些奶牛和山羊。卖出了奶牛的1/5和山羊的3/11后，剩下的奶牛和山羊数量相等。如果剩下704头奶牛和山羊，农场最初（1st）有多少头动物？
questions.hintZh: 把剩下的704头动物平均分为奶牛和山羊。这两个相等的数量分别是原来奶牛的4/5和原来山羊的8/11。

questions.question: 3/5 of the 60 balloons used at a party were green and the rest were yellow. If 6 green balloons and 3 yellow balloons burst, what fraction of the remaining balloons were green?
questions.hint: Find the original green and yellow balloon counts separately. Subtract the burst balloons, then write green remaining over total remaining.

en.strategy: Find the original counts by colour, subtract the burst balloons, and simplify the remaining green fraction.

steps.title: Find the original colour counts
steps.text: Green balloons: 3/5 of 60 = 36. Yellow balloons: 60 − 36 = 24.

steps.title: Subtract the burst balloons
steps.text: Green remaining: 36 − 6 = 30. Yellow remaining: 24 − 3 = 21. Total remaining: 30 + 21 = 51.

steps.title: Write and simplify the fraction
steps.text: The green fraction is 30/51. Divide numerator and denominator by 3 to get 10/17.

en.answerCheck: Check: 30 green balloons out of 51 remaining gives 30/51 = 10/17. Answer: 10/17.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求两种颜色原来的数量，减去爆破的气球，再约分剩余绿色气球所占的分数。

steps.title: 写出并约分分数
steps.text: 绿色所占分数是30/51。分子和分母都除以3，得到10/17。

questions.questionZh: 派对上使用的气球中，3/5是绿色的，气球总数为60个，其余是黄色的。如果6个绿色气球和3个黄色气球爆裂了，剩余气球中绿色气球占几分之几？
questions.hintZh: 分别求出原来绿色和黄色气球的数量。减去爆裂的气球，再写出剩余绿色气球数占剩余总数的分数。

questions.question: Peter was given a crate of cups. He sold all the cups. Each cup was sold at $8.90. For every set of 5 cups purchased by a customer, 1 cup was given free. 2/3 of the cups were sold in sets of 5 cups. He collected $1174.80 altogether. How many cups were there in the crate at 1st?
questions.hint: A set charges for 5 cups but contains 6 cups. Treat the remaining 1/3 as single cups, and use the total money to find the number of such groups.

en.strategy: Translate the stated 2/3 promotion condition into groups; this exposes an inconsistency between the wording and the supplied answer.

steps.title: Model a promotion group
steps.text: For every 5 cups purchased, 1 cup is free, so a promotion group contains 6 cups but brings in 5 × $8.90 = $44.50. If N cups were in the crate, 2/3N cups were in promotion groups and 1/3N cups were sold singly.

steps.title: Write the revenue equation
steps.text: The promotion groups bring in (2/3N) × 5/6 × $8.90, while the single cups bring in (1/3N) × $8.90. Thus total revenue is (5/9N + 1/3N) × $8.90 = 8/9N × $8.90.

steps.title: Check the stated data
steps.text: $1174.80 = 8/9N × $8.90 gives N = 148.5, not a whole number of cups. Therefore the stated 2/3 condition and $1174.80 total cannot both produce the supplied whole-number answer.

en.answerCheck: Source answer string: 156 cups. But 156 cups would produce 156 × 8/9 × $8.90 = $1234.13..., not $1174.80; the source wording or answer needs correction before a valid numerical answer check is possible.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把题目给出的2/3促销条件写成组数；这样会发现题干与给出的答案不一致。

steps.title: 表示1个促销组
steps.text: 顾客购买5个杯子送1个，所以1个促销组实际有6个杯子，收入为5 × $8.90 = $44.50。设箱中原有N个杯子，2/3N个按促销组出售，1/3N个单独出售。

steps.title: 检验题目数据
steps.text: $1174.80 = 8/9N × $8.90，得到N = 148.5，不是整数个杯子。因此题目中的2/3条件与$1174.80不能同时得出给出的整数答案。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 题库答案为156 cups。但156 × 8/9 × $8.90 = $1234.13...，不是$1174.80；需要更正题干或答案后才能进行有效检验。

questions.questionZh: 彼得得到了一箱杯子。他卖掉了所有杯子。每个杯子的售价是$8.90。顾客每购买一组5个杯子，就免费获赠1个杯子。杯子中有2/3是按每组5个的方式售出的。他总共收了$1174.80。箱子里最初（1st）有多少个杯子？
questions.hintZh: 一组杯子按5个收费，但实际包含6个杯子。把剩下的1/3视为单独出售的杯子，并利用总收入求出这类组的数量。

questions.question: Samantha, Jerry, Mandy and Tim scored an average of 68.75 points for a game. Tim's score was 2/3 of Mandy's score, Mandy's score was 1/2 of Jerry's score, and Samantha's score was 1/4 of Jerry's score. What was the average score of Mandy and Samantha?
questions.hint: Convert the average to the 4 players' total score. Express every score as a fraction of Jerry's score, then find Mandy and Samantha.

en.strategy: Convert the average to a total, write every score as a fraction of Jerry's score, and then average the two requested scores.

steps.title: Find the four-player total
steps.text: The total score is 4 × 68.75 = 275 points.

steps.title: Express all scores using Jerry
steps.text: Let Jerry's score be J. Mandy = 1/2J, Tim = 2/3 of Mandy = 1/3J, and Samantha = 1/4J. Thus J + 1/2J + 1/3J + 1/4J = 25/12J = 275.

steps.title: Find the requested average
steps.text: J = 132, so Mandy has 66 and Samantha has 33. Their average is (66 + 33) ÷ 2 = 49.5 points.

en.answerCheck: Check: Tim has 44, which is 2/3 of Mandy's 66; and 132 + 66 + 44 + 33 = 275. Answer: 49.5 points.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先把平均分换成总分，把每个人的得分表示为Jerry得分的分数，再求所需的平均分。

steps.title: 用Jerry的得分表示所有人
steps.text: 设Jerry得J分。Mandy = 1/2J，Tim = Mandy的2/3 = 1/3J，Samantha = 1/4J。因此J + 1/2J + 1/3J + 1/4J = 25/12J = 275。

steps.title: 求题目所需的平均分
steps.text: J = 132，所以Mandy得66分，Samantha得33分。她们的平均分是(66 + 33) ÷ 2 = 49.5分。

questions.questionZh: 萨曼莎、杰瑞、曼迪和蒂姆在一场比赛中的平均得分为68.75分。蒂姆的得分是曼迪得分的2/3，曼迪的得分是杰瑞得分的1/2，萨曼莎的得分是杰瑞得分的1/4。曼迪和萨曼莎的平均得分是多少？
questions.hintZh: 把平均分换算成4名参赛者的总分。把每个人的得分表示为杰瑞得分的分数，再求出曼迪和萨曼莎的得分。

questions.question: Jane, Alice and Peter had a sum of money. After Jane spent 1/4 of her money, Alice spent $80 of hers, and Peter spent 1/2 of his money, they had an equal amount of money left. If they had $1008 altogether in the end, how much did each have at 1st?
questions.hint: Divide the final $1008 into 3 equal remainders. Work backwards for each person using the fraction spent or the $80 spent.

en.strategy: First find the equal final amount for each person, then reverse each person's spending.

steps.title: Find each final amount
steps.text: Jane, Alice, and Peter have equal amounts left totaling $1008. Each has $1008 ÷ 3 = $336 left.

steps.title: Reverse Jane's and Alice's spending
steps.text: Jane has 3/4 of her original money left, so her original amount was $336 ÷ 3/4 = $448. Alice spent $80, so her original amount was $336 + $80 = $416.

steps.title: Reverse Peter's spending
steps.text: Peter has 1/2 of his original money left, so his original amount was $336 ÷ 1/2 = $672.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求3人最后相等的钱数，再分别倒推每个人花钱前的钱数。

steps.title: 求每人最后的钱数
steps.text: Jane、Alice和Peter最后的钱数相等，总共是$1008，所以每人有$1008 ÷ 3 = $336。

steps.title: 倒推Jane和Alice的钱数
steps.text: Jane花了原来钱数的1/4，剩下3/4，所以原来有$336 ÷ 3/4 = $448。Alice花了$80，所以原来有$336 + $80 = $416。

steps.title: 倒推Peter的钱数
steps.text: Peter剩下原来钱数的1/2，所以原来有$336 ÷ 1/2 = $672。

questions.questionZh: 简、爱丽丝和彼得有一笔钱。简花掉自己钱的1/4、爱丽丝花掉$80、彼得花掉自己钱的1/2后，他们剩下的钱数相等。如果最后他们一共有$1008，他们最初（1st）各有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 将最后的$1008平均分成3份相等的剩余金额。根据每个人花掉的分数或$80，分别倒推。

questions.question: A tank measures 20 cm by 15 cm by 30 cm. Pump A and Pump B release water in the ratio 3 : 2. Together, the pumps fill 1/2 litre of water in 2 minutes. How long will it take Pump B alone to fill the tank completely with water?
questions.hint: Find the tank's volume in cubic centimetres and the combined flow per minute. Split that flow in the 3:2 ratio, then use Pump B's rate.

en.strategy: Find the tank volume, calculate Pump B's share of the combined rate, and divide volume by that rate.

steps.title: Find the tank volume
steps.text: The tank holds 20 cm × 15 cm × 30 cm = 9000 cm³. Since 1000 cm³ = 1 litre, the tank holds 9 litres.

steps.title: Find Pump B's rate
steps.text: Together the pumps fill 1/2 litre in 2 minutes, so their combined rate is 1/4 litre per minute. Their rates are in a 3:2 ratio, so Pump B's rate is 2/5 × 1/4 = 1/10 litre per minute.

steps.title: Find the time
steps.text: At 1/10 litre per minute, Pump B takes 9 ÷ 1/10 = 90 minutes to fill 9 litres.

en.answerCheck: Check: in 90 minutes, Pump B fills 90 × 1/10 = 9 litres, which is 9000 cm³. Answer: 90 minutes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求水箱体积，再求Pump B占合并流速的份额，最后用体积除以流速。

steps.title: 求水箱体积
steps.text: 水箱体积是20 cm × 15 cm × 30 cm = 9000 cm³。因为1000 cm³ = 1 litre，水箱容积是9 litres。

steps.title: 求Pump B的流速
steps.text: 两台泵2分钟共注入1/2 litre，所以合并流速是每分钟1/4 litre。流速比为3 : 2，因此Pump B的流速是2/5 × 1/4 = 每分钟1/10 litre。

steps.title: 求所需时间
steps.text: Pump B每分钟注入1/10 litre，注满9 litres需要9 ÷ 1/10 = 90分钟。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 检验：90分钟内Pump B注入90 × 1/10 = 9 litres，即9000 cm³。答案：90分钟。

questions.questionZh: 一个水箱的尺寸为20 cm × 15 cm × 30 cm。Pump A和Pump B的出水量之比为3 : 2。两台泵一起注入1/2 litre的水需要2分钟。Pump B单独把水箱完全注满需要多长时间？
questions.hintZh: 求水箱的体积（单位为立方厘米）以及每分钟的合并流量。按3:2分配该流量，然后利用Pump B的流速。

questions.question: The costs of a book, toy and hat are in the ratio 5 : 2 : 9. Their average cost is $32. When a belt is added, the average cost of the 4 items is $30. What is the difference between the cost of the book and the belt?
questions.hint: Use the 1st average to find the total cost of the 3 items. Split that total into 16 ratio units, then use the 2nd average to find the belt's cost.

en.strategy: Use the first average to find the 3-item total and the ratio unit, then use the 4-item average to find the belt.

steps.title: Find the book's cost
steps.text: The book, toy, and hat cost 3 × $32 = $96 altogether. Their ratio has 5 + 2 + 9 = 16 units, so 1 unit is $96 ÷ 16 = $6. The book costs 5 × $6 = $30.

steps.title: Find the belt's cost
steps.text: With the belt, the 4 items cost 4 × $30 = $120. Therefore the belt costs $120 − $96 = $24.

steps.title: Compare the costs
steps.text: The difference is $30 − $24 = $6.

en.answerCheck: The checked difference between the book and the belt is $6.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用第1个平均数求3件物品的总价和比的每份金额，再用4件物品的平均数求皮带价格。

steps.title: 求皮带的价格
steps.text: 加上皮带后，4件物品总价是4 × $30 = $120。因此皮带价格是$120 − $96 = $24。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：书和皮带的价格相差$6。

questions.questionZh: 一本书、一个玩具和一顶帽子的价格之比是5 : 2 : 9。它们的平均价格是$32。加入一条皮带后，4件物品的平均价格是$30。书和皮带的价格相差多少？
questions.hintZh: 利用第1个平均数求3件物品的总价。把总价按16个比的单位分配，再利用第2个平均数求皮带的价格。

questions.question: ACEH is a rectangle. Its length is 5 times its breadth, and its length is 30 cm. BC is 12 cm. D is the midpoint of CE and G is the midpoint of HF. In the diagram, segments BD and BG form 2 unshaded triangles, BCD and BFG. Find the total area of the shaded portions.
questions.hint: Find the rectangle's breadth from its length-to-breadth relationship. Find the area of the whole rectangle, then subtract the areas of triangles BCD and BFG.

en.strategy: Find the rectangle's dimensions, calculate its area, and subtract the two unshaded triangles.

steps.title: Find the rectangle area
steps.text: The breadth is 30 ÷ 5 = 6 cm, so rectangle ACEH has area 30 × 6 = 180 cm2.

steps.title: Find triangle BCD
steps.text: D is the midpoint of CE, so CD = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm. Area of triangle BCD = 1/2 × 12 × 3 = 18 cm2.

steps.title: Find triangle BFG and subtract
steps.text: BF = 6 cm and HF = 30 − 12 = 18 cm, so midpoint G gives FG = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm. Area of triangle BFG = 1/2 × 9 × 6 = 27 cm2. Shaded area = 180 − 18 − 27 = 135 cm2.

en.answerCheck: The checked total shaded area is 135 cm2.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求长方形的尺寸和面积，再减去2个未阴影三角形的面积。

steps.title: 求长方形面积
steps.text: 宽是30 ÷ 5 = 6 cm，所以长方形ACEH的面积是30 × 6 = 180 cm2。

steps.title: 求三角形BCD的面积
steps.text: D是CE的中点，所以CD = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm。三角形BCD的面积是1/2 × 12 × 3 = 18 cm2。

steps.title: 求三角形BFG并相减
steps.text: BF = 6 cm，HF = 30 − 12 = 18 cm；G是HF的中点，所以FG = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 cm。三角形BFG的面积是1/2 × 9 × 6 = 27 cm2。阴影总面积是180 − 18 − 27 = 135 cm2。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：阴影部分总面积是135 cm2。

questions.questionZh: ACEH是一个长方形。它的长是宽的5倍，长为30 cm。BC为12 cm。D是CE的中点，G是HF的中点。在图中，线段BD和BG形成2个未阴影三角形BCD和BFG。求阴影部分的总面积。
questions.hintZh: 根据长与宽的关系求长方形的宽。求整个长方形的面积，再减去三角形BCD和BFG的面积。

questions.question: Mrs Baker bought some flour. She used 1/4 of it to bake 6 cherry pies and packed the rest equally into 9 bags. There was 250 g more flour in 2 similar bags than in 1 cherry pie. If all the flour were packed into 25 bags instead, how much flour would there be in each bag?
questions.hint: Express the flour for 1 pie and for 2 bags as fractions of the original amount. Their difference represents 250 g.

en.strategy: Express one pie and two packed bags as fractions of the original flour, then use their 250 g difference.

steps.title: Express the pie and bag amounts
steps.text: 1/4 of the flour makes 6 pies, so 1 pie is 1/4 ÷ 6 = 1/24 of the original flour. The remaining 3/4 is split into 9 bags, so 1 bag is 3/4 ÷ 9 = 1/12; 2 bags hold 1/6.

steps.title: Find the original amount
steps.text: The difference is 1/6 − 1/24 = 3/24 = 1/8 of the flour, and it is 250 g. Thus all the flour is 8 × 250 g = 2000 g.

steps.title: Repack into 25 bags
steps.text: 2000 g ÷ 25 = 80 g per bag.

en.answerCheck: The checked amount in each of 25 bags is 80 g.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把1个派和2袋面粉表示为原有面粉的分数，再利用250 g的差额求总量。

questions.questionZh: Baker太太买了一些面粉。她用其中的1/4烤了6个樱桃派，其余的平均装入9个袋子。2个相同袋子中的面粉比1个樱桃派中的面粉多250 g。如果改为把全部面粉装入25个袋子，每个袋子中有多少面粉？
questions.hintZh: 把1个派和2个袋子中的面粉分别表示为原有面粉的分数。它们的差额就是250 g。

questions.question: The average mass of 3 full bags, A, B and C, is 38 kg. When all the items from bag A are taken out, the average mass of the 3 bags is 30 kg. The masses of the items in bags B and C are in the ratio 7 : 3. If the items in bag B are 20 kg heavier than the items in bag C, what is the total mass of the 3 empty bags?
questions.hint: Compare the 2 averages to find the mass of the items from bag A. Use the 7 : 3 ratio and the 20 kg difference to find the masses in bags B and C.

en.strategy: Use the change in the averages to find bag A's contents, use the 7:3 ratio for bags B and C, then subtract all item masses from the full-bag mass.

steps.title: Find bag A's item mass
steps.text: The full bags weigh 3 × 38 = 114 kg. After bag A is emptied, they weigh 3 × 30 = 90 kg, so bag A's items weigh 114 − 90 = 24 kg.

steps.title: Find the masses in B and C
steps.text: The 7 : 3 ratio differs by 4 units, which is 20 kg. Thus 1 unit is 20 ÷ 4 = 5 kg, so bags B and C contain 7 × 5 = 35 kg and 3 × 5 = 15 kg.

steps.title: Subtract the item masses
steps.text: All items weigh 24 + 35 + 15 = 74 kg. The 3 empty bags weigh 114 − 74 = 40 kg.

en.answerCheck: The checked total mass of the 3 empty bags is 40 kg.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用平均质量的变化求A袋物品的质量，再按7 : 3求B、C袋物品质量，最后从满袋总质量中减去物品质量。

steps.title: 求A袋物品质量
steps.text: 3个满袋的总质量是3 × 38 = 114 kg。取出A袋物品后总质量是3 × 30 = 90 kg，所以A袋物品质量是114 − 90 = 24 kg。

steps.title: 求B、C袋物品质量
steps.text: 7 : 3相差4份，对应20 kg。因此1份是20 ÷ 4 = 5 kg，B袋和C袋物品质量分别是7 × 5 = 35 kg和3 × 5 = 15 kg。

steps.title: 减去物品质量
steps.text: 所有物品质量是24 + 35 + 15 = 74 kg。3个空袋总质量是114 − 74 = 40 kg。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：3个空袋的总质量是40 kg。

questions.questionZh: 3个装满物品的袋子A、B和C的平均质量是38 kg。取出A袋中的所有物品后，3个袋子的平均质量是30 kg。B袋和C袋中物品的质量之比是7 : 3。如果B袋中的物品比C袋中的物品重20 kg，3个空袋子的总质量是多少？
questions.hintZh: 比较2个平均数，求A袋中物品的质量。利用7 : 3的比和20 kg的差额，求B袋和C袋中物品的质量。

questions.question: A tank contains 2520 cm3 of sand. 1/5 of the sand is poured into a rectangular container that already contains 7112 cm3 of sand. The container has a base of 16 cm by 28 cm. What is the final height of sand in the container?
questions.hint: Find the volume poured in, add it to the sand already in the container, then divide by the base area.

en.strategy: Find the sand poured into the container, add it to the sand already there, and divide by the base area.

steps.title: Find the added sand
steps.text: The poured sand is 1/5 × 2520 = 504 cm3.

steps.title: Find the final volume and base area
steps.text: Final sand volume = 7112 + 504 = 7616 cm3. The base area is 16 × 28 = 448 cm2.

steps.title: Find the height
steps.text: Height = 7616 cm3 ÷ 448 cm2 = 17 cm.

en.answerCheck: The checked final sand height is 17 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求倒入容器的沙量，加上原有沙量，再除以底面积。
zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：最后沙的高度是17 cm。

questions.questionZh: 一个箱子里有2520 cm3的沙。将其中的1/5倒入一个长方体容器中，该容器原来已有7112 cm3的沙。容器的底面长16 cm、宽28 cm。容器中沙最后的高度是多少？
questions.hintZh: 先求倒入的沙的体积，加到容器中原有的沙上，再除以底面积。

questions.question: In rectangle ABEG, the ratio of the shaded area to the unshaded area is 5 : 3, and the rectangle's area is 152 cm2. The area of triangle BCE is to the area of triangle AGF as 3 : 2. Triangle CDE has area 1/4 of the area of rectangle ABEG. Find the difference between the total shaded area and the total unshaded area of the figure.
questions.hint: Use the 5 : 3 split to find the shaded and unshaded areas inside the rectangle. Then use the triangle-area ratio and add the appropriate outside triangles.

en.strategy: Split rectangle ABEG by the 5:3 area ratio, then use the given triangle information to total all shaded and unshaded parts.

steps.title: Split rectangle ABEG
steps.text: The 5 : 3 split has 8 units. Each unit is 152 ÷ 8 = 19 cm2, so the shaded part in the rectangle is 5 × 19 = 95 cm2 and the unshaded part is 3 × 19 = 57 cm2.

steps.title: Find the outside triangle areas
steps.text: Triangle CDE is 1/4 × 152 = 38 cm2. Triangle AGF is the 57 cm2 unshaded triangle. Since BCE : AGF = 3 : 2, triangle BCE has area 57 ÷ 2 × 3 = 85.5 cm2.

steps.title: Compare the totals
steps.text: Total shaded area = 95 + 85.5 = 180.5 cm2. Total unshaded area = 57 + 38 = 95 cm2. Difference = 180.5 − 95 = 85.5 cm2.

en.answerCheck: The checked difference between total shaded and unshaded area is 85.5 cm2.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先按5 : 3分出长方形ABEG的面积，再用三角形条件分别合计阴影和未阴影面积。

steps.title: 分出长方形ABEG的面积
steps.text: 5 : 3共8份。每份是152 ÷ 8 = 19 cm2，所以长方形内的阴影面积是5 × 19 = 95 cm2，未阴影面积是3 × 19 = 57 cm2。

steps.title: 求外部三角形面积
steps.text: 三角形CDE的面积是1/4 × 152 = 38 cm2。三角形AGF是面积为57 cm2的未阴影三角形。BCE : AGF = 3 : 2，所以三角形BCE的面积是57 ÷ 2 × 3 = 85.5 cm2。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：阴影总面积与未阴影总面积相差85.5 cm2。

questions.questionZh: 在长方形ABEG中，阴影面积与未阴影面积之比是5 : 3，且该长方形的面积是152 cm2。三角形BCE的面积与三角形AGF的面积之比是3 : 2。三角形CDE的面积是长方形ABEG面积的1/4。求图形中阴影总面积与未阴影总面积的差。
questions.hintZh: 利用5 : 3的分配求长方形内的阴影和未阴影面积。然后利用三角形面积之比，加上相应的外部三角形面积。

questions.question: Aaron bought 2 similar books and 3 similar rulers for $40.30. Sharon bought 3 such books and 5 such rulers for $61. What was the combined cost of 1 book and 1 ruler?
questions.hint: Subtract Aaron's purchase from Sharon's to get the cost of 1 book and 2 rulers. Compare that result with Aaron's total.

en.strategy: Subtract the two purchases to obtain one book and two rulers, then compare that with Aaron's purchase to obtain one book and one ruler.

steps.title: Subtract the purchases
steps.text: Sharon bought 1 more book and 2 more rulers than Aaron, costing $61 − $40.30 = $20.70. Thus 1 book + 2 rulers costs $20.70.

steps.title: Compare with Aaron's total
steps.text: Aaron's total is 2 books + 3 rulers = $40.30. Subtracting 1 book + 2 rulers leaves 1 book + 1 ruler: $40.30 − $20.70 = $19.60.

en.answerCheck: The checked combined cost of 1 book and 1 ruler is $19.60.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用2次购买相减求1本书和2把尺子的价格，再与Aaron的购买总价比较。

steps.title: 2次购买相减
steps.text: Sharon比Aaron多买1本书和2把尺子，价格是$61 − $40.30 = $20.70。因此1本书和2把尺子共$20.70。

steps.title: 与Aaron的总价比较
steps.text: Aaron的总价是2本书和3把尺子，共$40.30。减去1本书和2把尺子后，剩1本书和1把尺子：$40.30 − $20.70 = $19.60。

questions.questionZh: Aaron以$40.30买了2本相同的书和3把相同的尺子。Sharon以$61买了3本这样的书和5把这样的尺子。1本书和1把尺子的总价是多少？
questions.hintZh: 用Sharon的购买总价减去Aaron的购买总价，得到1本书和2把尺子的价格。再把这个结果与Aaron的总价比较。

questions.question: A tank measuring 12 cm by 16 cm by 24 cm is 2/3 filled with water. 1/2 of that water fills 2/5 of a basin. What is the capacity of the basin?
questions.hint: Find the tank's water volume first. The transferred water is 2/5 of the basin, so scale it from 2 units to 5 units.

en.strategy: Find the water volume in the tank, take half of it, and scale that amount from 2/5 to the whole basin.

steps.title: Find the tank's water
steps.text: Tank capacity = 12 × 16 × 24 = 4608 cm3. It is 2/3 full, so its water volume is 2/3 × 4608 = 3072 cm3.

steps.title: Scale from 2/5 to the whole basin
steps.text: Half the tank water is 3072 ÷ 2 = 1536 cm3, and this is 2/5 of the basin. Therefore 1/5 is 1536 ÷ 2 = 768 cm3, so the basin capacity is 5 × 768 = 3840 cm3.

en.answerCheck: The checked capacity of the basin is 3840 cm3.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求水箱中的水量，取其中的1/2，再把对应2/5的水量还原成整个盆的容量。

questions.questionZh: 一个水箱的尺寸是12 cm × 16 cm × 24 cm，里面装有容量的2/3的水。其中的1/2装满一个盆的2/5。这个盆的容量是多少？
questions.hintZh: 先求水箱中的水量。倒出的水是盆容量的2/5，所以把它从2个单位按比例扩大到5个单位。

questions.question: A rectangle has length-to-breadth ratio 7 : 3 and perimeter 280 cm. A diagonal is drawn from the top-left corner to the midpoint of the bottom side, leaving 1 unshaded triangle. What is the area of the shaded portion?
questions.hint: Use the perimeter to find the value of 1 ratio unit and hence both rectangle dimensions. Then subtract the midpoint triangle from the rectangle.

en.strategy: Use the perimeter and 7:3 ratio to find the rectangle dimensions, then subtract the midpoint triangle from the rectangle.

steps.title: Find the dimensions
steps.text: 2(length + breadth) = 280, so length + breadth = 140. The ratio has 7 + 3 = 10 units, so 1 unit is 140 ÷ 10 = 14 cm. Length = 7 × 14 = 98 cm and breadth = 3 × 14 = 42 cm.

steps.title: Find the rectangle and triangle areas
steps.text: Rectangle area = 98 × 42 = 4116 cm2. The triangle has base 98 ÷ 2 = 49 cm and height 42 cm, so its area is 1/2 × 49 × 42 = 1029 cm2.

steps.title: Subtract the unshaded triangle
steps.text: Shaded area = 4116 − 1029 = 3087 cm2.

en.answerCheck: The checked shaded area is 3087 cm2.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用周长和7 : 3求长方形的长、宽，再从长方形面积中减去以中点为顶点的未阴影三角形。

steps.title: 求长方形和三角形面积

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：阴影部分面积是3087 cm2。

questions.questionZh: 一个长方形的长与宽之比是7 : 3，周长为280 cm。从左上角向底边的中点画一条对角线，留下1个未阴影三角形。阴影部分的面积是多少？
questions.hintZh: 利用周长求1个比的单位的值，从而求出长方形的长和宽。然后从长方形中减去以中点为顶点的三角形面积。

questions.question: In the figure, GF is 2/5 of BG, JG is 2/5 of AF, GF is 3/5 of HF, EC is 1/2 of FC, and FC = AF. AFC is a straight line. AF = 18 cm, BG = 12 cm, and ED = 10 cm. Find the total area of the shaded portions.
questions.hint: Use the fractional relationships to find GF, JG, HF and EC. Work out the areas of the component triangles before combining shaded and unshaded parts.

en.strategy: Use the fractional length relationships to calculate the component triangles, then subtract the one unshaded triangle from the whole figure.

steps.title: Find the unknown lengths
steps.text: GF = 2/5 × BG = 2/5 × 12 = 4.8 cm. JG = 2/5 × AF = 2/5 × 18 = 7.2 cm. Since GF = 3/5 of HF, HF = 4.8 ÷ 3 × 5 = 8 cm. Also EC = 1/2 × FC = 9 cm and BF = BG + GF = 12 + 4.8 = 16.8 cm.

steps.title: Calculate the shaded total
steps.text: Whole figure area = 151.2 + 45 + 72 = 268.2 cm2. The unshaded triangle BGJ is 43.2 cm2, so shaded area = 268.2 − 43.2 = 225 cm2.

en.answerCheck: The checked total shaded area is 225 cm2.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用分数长度关系求各线段，再计算组成三角形的面积，最后从整个图形中减去未阴影三角形。

steps.title: 计算阴影总面积
steps.text: 整个图形面积 = 151.2 + 45 + 72 = 268.2 cm2。未阴影三角形BGJ面积为43.2 cm2，所以阴影面积 = 268.2 − 43.2 = 225 cm2。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：阴影部分总面积是225 cm2。

questions.questionZh: 在图中，GF是BG的2/5，JG是AF的2/5，GF是HF的3/5，EC是FC的1/2，且FC = AF。AFC是一条直线。AF = 18 cm，BG = 12 cm，ED = 10 cm。求阴影部分的总面积。
questions.hintZh: 利用这些分数关系求GF、JG、HF和EC。先求各组成三角形的面积，再合并阴影和未阴影部分。

questions.question: A tank measures 25 cm by 18 cm by 30 cm. It is filled to 3/5 of its capacity. Some water is then poured into 2 similar containers, filling them to the brim. Then 950 cm3 of water is added to the tank until it is 1/2 full. What is the capacity of each container?
questions.hint: Find the tank's capacity and compare the amount at 3/5 full with the amount that must have been in it before the final 950 cm3 was added.

en.strategy: Compare the 3/5-full volume with the volume left just before the final 950 cm3 was added, then split the poured amount equally between 2 containers.

steps.title: Find the tank volumes
steps.text: Tank capacity = 25 × 18 × 30 = 13500 cm3. At 3/5 full it contains 3/5 × 13500 = 8100 cm3. At 1/2 full it contains 13500 ÷ 2 = 6750 cm3.

steps.title: Find the water transferred
steps.text: Before the final 950 cm3 was added, the tank held 6750 − 950 = 5800 cm3. Thus 8100 − 5800 = 2300 cm3 was poured into the 2 containers.

steps.title: Split between the containers
steps.text: Each similar container holds 2300 ÷ 2 = 1150 cm3.

en.answerCheck: The checked capacity of each container is 1150 cm3.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较水箱3/5满时的水量与加入最后950 cm3之前的水量，再把倒出的水平均分给2个容器。

steps.title: 求倒出的水量
steps.text: 加入最后950 cm3之前，水箱有6750 − 950 = 5800 cm3。因此倒入2个容器的水量是8100 − 5800 = 2300 cm3。

steps.title: 平均分给2个容器
steps.text: 每个相同容器的容量是2300 ÷ 2 = 1150 cm3。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：每个容器的容量是1150 cm3。

questions.questionZh: 一个水箱的尺寸是25 cm × 18 cm × 30 cm。它装有容量的3/5的水。随后，一些水被倒入2个相同的容器中，恰好装满。然后向水箱加入950 cm3的水，直到水箱达到1/2满。每个容器的容量是多少？
questions.hintZh: 求水箱的容量，并比较3/5满时的水量与加入最后950 cm3之前水箱中的水量。

questions.question: Josephine had $80 more than Alex. If Alex gave Josephine $16, Josephine would have 3 times as much money as Alex. How much did each have at first?
questions.hint: After the $16 transfer, preserve the original $80 difference while accounting for the $16 lost by Alex and the $16 gained by Josephine.

en.strategy: Adjust the original $80 difference for the $16 transfer in both directions, then use the final 3:1 ratio.

steps.title: Find the final difference
steps.text: Josephine originally had $80 more. Receiving $16 while Alex gives $16 increases the difference by $16 + $16 = $32, so the final difference is $80 + $32 = $112.

steps.title: Use the final ratio
steps.text: After the transfer, Josephine : Alex = 3 : 1. The difference of 2 units is $112, so 1 unit is $112 ÷ 2 = $56. Josephine then has 3 × $56 = $168 and Alex has $56.

steps.title: Reverse the transfer
steps.text: Initially Josephine had $168 − $16 = $152, and Alex had $56 + $16 = $72.

en.answerCheck: The checked initial amounts are Josephine: $152; Alex: $72.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先把原来的$80差额按$16转账的双方变化调整，再用最后的3 : 1关系求解。

steps.title: 求最后的差额
steps.text: Josephine原来多$80。她收到$16而Alex付出$16，差额增加$16 + $16 = $32，所以最后差额是$80 + $32 = $112。

steps.title: 利用最后的比
steps.text: 转账后Josephine : Alex = 3 : 1，2份的差额是$112，所以1份是$112 ÷ 2 = $56。Josephine当时有3 × $56 = $168，Alex有$56。

questions.questionZh: Josephine的钱比Alex多$80。如果Alex给Josephine $16，Josephine的钱将是Alex的3倍。他们最初各有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 在$16转账后，保留原来的$80差额，同时考虑Alex少了$16以及Josephine多了$16。

questions.question: A bag costs $24.50 more than a wallet. The total cost of 2 bags and 1 wallet is $85. What is the total cost of 3 wallets and 3 bags?
questions.hint: Remove the 2 bag-to-wallet price differences from the $85 total. The remainder represents 3 wallets.

en.strategy: Remove the two bag-over-wallet price differences from the first total, then find each price and total 3 of each item.

steps.title: Find the wallet price
steps.text: Two bags contain two extra $24.50 differences, totaling 2 × $24.50 = $49. Removing this from $85 leaves $85 − $49 = $36 for 3 wallets, so 1 wallet costs $36 ÷ 3 = $12.

steps.title: Find the bag price and required total

en.answerCheck: The checked total cost of 3 wallets and 3 bags is $145.50.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先从总价中减去2个包比钱包多出的价格，再求单价并计算各3个的总价。

steps.title: 求包的价格和所求总价

questions.questionZh: 一个包比一个钱包贵$24.50。2个包和1个钱包的总价是$85。3个钱包和3个包的总价是多少？
questions.hintZh: 从$85的总价中减去2个包相对钱包多出的价格。余下的金额代表3个钱包的价格。

questions.question: Clarence withdrew 25% of his savings on Monday. He spent $720 on a television set, $163 on a radio and the remaining $37 on a clock. The following day, he deposited 2/5 of his salary into the bank. His bank balance then became $4680. Find Clarence's salary.
questions.hint: Add the 3 purchases to find 25% of the original savings. Find the balance after withdrawal, then the amount deposited from the salary.

en.strategy: Add the purchases to identify 25% of Clarence's savings, then use the final balance to find the salary deposit.

steps.title: Find the original savings
steps.text: The withdrawal was $720 + $163 + $37 = $920, which was 25% of the savings. Therefore original savings = $920 ÷ 25 × 100 = $3680.

steps.title: Find the salary deposit
steps.text: The balance after withdrawing $920 was $3680 − $920 = $2760. The next-day deposit was $4680 − $2760 = $1920.

steps.title: Find the salary
steps.text: $1920 is 2/5 of the salary. Thus 1/5 is $1920 ÷ 2 = $960, and the salary is 5 × $960 = $4800.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先把购买金额相加，得到Clarence储蓄的25%，再用最后余额求出工资存款额。

questions.questionZh: Clarence在星期一取出其储蓄的25%。他花了$720买一台电视机、$163买一台收音机，剩下的$37买一个时钟。第二天，他把工资的2/5存入银行。此后他的银行余额变为$4680。求Clarence的工资。
questions.hintZh: 把3笔购买金额相加，得到原有储蓄的25%。求取款后的余额，再求从工资中存入的金额。

questions.question: James is 8 years old. Last year, his father was 4 times James's age. In how many years' time will their combined age be 51?
questions.hint: Find the father's age last year, then their current combined age. Their combined age increases by 2 each year.

en.strategy: Find the father's current age from last year's relationship, then use the fact that their combined age rises by 2 each year.

steps.title: Find the current combined age
steps.text: Last year James was 7, so his father was 4 × 7 = 28 years old. This year his father is 28 + 1 = 29, and their combined age is 8 + 29 = 37.

steps.title: Find the elapsed years
steps.text: They need 51 − 37 = 14 more combined years. Their combined age increases by 2 each year, so 14 ÷ 2 = 7 years are needed.

en.answerCheck: Their checked combined age reaches 51 in 7 years' time.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先根据去年的年龄关系求父亲现在的年龄，再利用James和父亲的年龄和每年增加2。

steps.title: 求现在的年龄和
steps.text: 去年James是7岁，所以父亲是4 × 7 = 28岁。今年父亲是28 + 1 = 29岁，James和父亲的年龄和是8 + 29 = 37。

steps.title: 求经过的年数
steps.text: 年龄和还需要51 − 37 = 14。James和父亲的年龄和每年增加2，所以需要14 ÷ 2 = 7年。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：再过7年，James和父亲的年龄和是51。

questions.questionZh: James今年8岁。去年，他父亲的年龄是James年龄的4倍。再过多少年，他们的年龄和将达到51？
questions.hintZh: 先求父亲去年的年龄，再求他们目前的年龄和。他们的年龄和每年增加2。

questions.question: Anna made full payment for a refrigerator at a 20% discount during a sale. Joan paid a down payment of $399 and 12 monthly instalments of $250. Joan's total was 10% more than Anna's sale price. What was the refrigerator's price before the sale?
questions.hint: Find Joan's total payment. Work backward through the 10% increase to get Anna's sale price, then reverse the 20% discount.

en.strategy: Find Joan's total payment, reverse the 10% increase to get Anna's sale price, then reverse the 20% discount.

steps.title: Find Anna's sale price
steps.text: $3399 is 110% of Anna's sale price. Therefore 1% is $3399 ÷ 110 = $30.90, and Anna's sale price is 100 × $30.90 = $3090.

steps.title: Reverse the discount
steps.text: Anna's sale price was 80% of the original price. Thus 1% is $3090 ÷ 80 = $38.625, and the original price is 100 × $38.625 = $3862.50.

en.answerCheck: The checked refrigerator price before the sale is $3862.50.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求Joan的总付款，倒推10%的增加求Anna的售价，再倒推20%的折扣。
zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：冰箱的折扣前价格是$3862.50。

questions.questionZh: Anna在促销期间以20%的折扣一次性付清冰箱款。Joan支付了$399的首付款和12期每期$250的月供。Joan支付的总额比Anna的促销价高10%。这台冰箱促销前的价格是多少？
questions.hintZh: 求Joan支付的总额。通过10%的增加倒推Anna的促销价，再还原20%的折扣。

questions.question: Jessica spent 2/3 of her money on a book and a toy. Don spent 1/5 of his money on the same items. The book cost $18 and the toy cost $6 less. How much more money did Don have than Jessica at first?
questions.hint: First find the cost of the book and toy together. Treat that same cost as 2/3 of Jessica's money and 1/5 of Don's money.

en.strategy: Find the common cost of the book and toy, then treat it as 2/3 of Jessica's money and 1/5 of Don's money.

steps.title: Find the cost of both items
steps.text: The toy costs $18 − $6 = $12. Together, the book and toy cost $18 + $12 = $30.

steps.title: Find each starting amount
steps.text: For Jessica, $30 is 2/3 of her money, so she had $30 ÷ 2 × 3 = $45. For Don, $30 is 1/5 of his money, so he had $30 × 5 = $150.

steps.title: Find the difference
steps.text: Don had $150 − $45 = $105 more than Jessica.

en.answerCheck: The checked difference in their initial money is $105.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求书和玩具的共同价格，再把它分别看作Jessica钱的2/3和Don钱的1/5。

steps.title: 求原有金额
steps.text: 对Jessica，$30是她钱的2/3，所以她有$30 ÷ 2 × 3 = $45。对Don，$30是他钱的1/5，所以他有$30 × 5 = $150。

steps.title: 求差额
steps.text: Don比Jessica多$150 − $45 = $105。

questions.questionZh: Jessica把她的钱的2/3花在一本书和一个玩具上。Don把他的钱的1/5花在同样的物品上。这本书的价格是$18，玩具的价格少$6。起初Don比Jessica多多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先求书和玩具的总价。把这个相同的价格分别看作Jessica钱的2/3和Don钱的1/5。

questions.question: Sean deposited $1500 in a bank at 3% interest per year. After 2 years, he took out 1/3 of the money. The interest rate remained 3% each year. How much did he have left in the bank?
questions.hint: Add 3% interest after the 1st year, then calculate 3% of that new balance for the 2nd year. Finally keep 2/3 of the amount.

en.strategy: Apply 3% interest to each year's balance, then leave 2/3 after the withdrawal.

steps.title: Subtract the withdrawal
steps.text: Sean withdraws 1/3, so 2/3 remains: $1591.35 × 2/3 = $1060.90.

zh-Hans.strategy: 每年按当时余额计算 3% 利息，再留下取款后的 2/3。

questions.questionZh: 肖恩在银行存入$1500，年利率为3%。2年后，他取出其中1/3的钱。此后年利率仍为每年3%。他在银行里还剩多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先加上第1年的3%利息，然后按这个新余额计算第2年的3%利息。最后保留总额的2/3。

questions.question: Jason had a sum of money and spent an equal amount each day. After 6 days, he had 3/5 of his money left. After 3 more days, he had $360 left. What was the sum of money he had at first?
questions.hint: The 3 extra days account for the drop from 3/5 to the final amount. Relate those days to equal parts of the original sum.

en.strategy: Find the fraction spent per day, then use the final $360.

steps.title: Find daily spending
steps.text: In 6 days, Jason spends 1 − 3/5 = 2/5, so each day he spends 2/5 ÷ 6 = 1/15 of the original sum.

steps.title: Use the next 3 days
steps.text: The next 3 days use 3/15 = 1/5, leaving 3/5 − 1/5 = 2/5. Thus 2/5 is $360, and the original sum is $360 × 5/2 = $900.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求每天花掉原有金额的分数，再利用最后的 $360。

questions.questionZh: 杰森有一笔钱，每天花掉相同的金额。6天后，他还剩原有钱数的3/5。再过3天后，他还剩$360。他起初有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 额外的3天对应于钱数从3/5降至最终金额的部分。把这些天数与原来总额的相等份数联系起来。

questions.question: A tank measuring 15 cm by 24 cm by 28 cm is 3/4 filled with water. When 45% of the water is poured into an empty container, the container becomes 2/5 full. What is the base area of the container if its height is 30 cm?
questions.hint: Find the water volume in the tank and then 45% of it. That transferred amount is 2/5 of the container's capacity.

en.strategy: Find the transferred water, use it as 2/5 of the container, then divide by its height.

steps.title: Find the transferred volume
steps.text: Tank capacity = 15 × 24 × 28 = 10080 cm3. Water in it = 3/4 × 10080 = 7560 cm3. Transferred water = 45% × 7560 = 3402 cm3.

steps.title: Find the base area
steps.text: 3402 cm3 is 2/5 of the container, so capacity = 3402 × 5/2 = 8505 cm3. Base area = 8505 ÷ 30 = 283.5 cm2.

en.answerCheck: The container's base area is 283.5 cm2.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求倒出的水量，把它作为容器的 2/5，再除以容器的高。

questions.questionZh: 一个长15 cm、宽24 cm、高28 cm的水箱装有3/4的水。将其中45%的水倒入一个空容器后，该容器装至2/5满。如果该容器高30 cm，它的底面积是多少？
questions.hintZh: 先求水箱中的水量，再求其45%。倒入容器的水量是该容器容量的2/5。

questions.question: ABCD is a rectangular room measuring 24 m by 13 m. The unshaded areas AEH, JCF and GDH are in the ratio 6 : 7 : 5. Mr Lee paints the remaining shaded area at $10 per square metre. If painting GDH costs $125, how much will it cost to paint the shaded area?
questions.hint: Convert the cost of painting GDH into its area. Use the 6 : 7 : 5 ratio to find all unshaded area, then subtract it from the room.

en.strategy: Turn the known cost into an area, use the 6 : 7 : 5 ratio, then subtract from the room area.

steps.title: Find unshaded area
steps.text: GDH area = $125 ÷ $10 = 12.5 m2. This is 5 parts, so 1 part = 2.5 m2. AEH = 15 m2 and JCF = 17.5 m2; total unshaded area = 45 m2.

steps.title: Find the cost
steps.text: Room area = 24 × 13 = 312 m2. Shaded area = 312 − 45 = 267 m2, so painting costs 267 × $10 = $2670.

en.answerCheck: It will cost $2670 to paint the shaded area.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把已知费用换成面积，利用 6 : 7 : 5，再从房间面积中减去未涂色部分。

steps.title: 求未涂色面积
steps.text: GDH 面积 = $125 ÷ $10 = 12.5 m2。这是 5 份，所以 1 份 = 2.5 m2。AEH = 15 m2，JCF = 17.5 m2；未涂色总面积 = 45 m2。

questions.questionZh: ABCD是一个长24 m、宽13 m的长方形房间。未阴影部分AEH、JCF和GDH的面积比为6 : 7 : 5。李先生以每平方米$10的价格给剩余的阴影部分刷漆。若给GDH刷漆的费用为$125，给阴影部分刷漆需要多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 将给GDH刷漆的费用换算成其面积。利用6 : 7 : 5求出所有未阴影部分的面积，再从房间面积中减去它。

questions.question: There were 980 pears and oranges in a basket. After 1/3 of the pears and 230 oranges were sold, the ratio of pears to oranges left was 2 : 3. What was the ratio of pears to oranges at first?
questions.hint: Represent the remaining pears and oranges with a 2 : 3 bar. Restore the 1/3 of pears and the 230 oranges that were sold.

en.strategy: Use the final 2 : 3 ratio to relate the original pear and orange totals.

steps.title: Set up the final ratio
steps.text: Let the original amounts be P pears and O oranges. Then (2/3P) : (O − 230) = 2 : 3, so 2P = 2(O − 230), or P = O − 230.

en.answerCheck: The ratio of pears to oranges at first was 75 : 121.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用最后的 2 : 3 比关联原来梨和橙子的数量。

questions.questionZh: 一个篮子里有980个梨和橙子。卖掉1/3的梨和230个橙子后，剩下的梨与橙子的比为2 : 3。起初梨与橙子的比是多少？
questions.hintZh: 用2 : 3的线段图表示剩下的梨和橙子。把卖掉的1/3的梨和230个橙子加回去。

questions.question: The ratio of Harry's cards to William's cards was 3 : 4. After Harry bought 12 cards and William lost 24 cards, the ratio became 3 : 2. Find the total number of cards Harry and William had at first.
questions.hint: Draw before-and-after bars with the 2 ratios. Compare the change in the gap between their amounts, including both the 12 gained and 24 lost.

en.strategy: Represent the original 3 : 4 ratio with a common unit and apply the changed ratio.

steps.title: Write both amounts after the changes
steps.text: Let the original counts be 3k and 4k. Then (3k + 12) : (4k − 24) = 3 : 2.

steps.title: Solve for the total
steps.text: 2(3k + 12) = 3(4k − 24), so 6k + 24 = 12k − 72 and k = 16. Original total = 3k + 4k = 7 × 16 = 112 cards.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把原来的 3 : 4 比表示成同一个单位，再使用变化后的比。

questions.questionZh: 哈里的卡片数与威廉的卡片数之比为3 : 4。哈里买了12张卡片，威廉丢失了24张卡片后，这个比变为3 : 2。求哈里和威廉起初共有多少张卡片。
questions.hintZh: 根据这2个比画出变化前后的线段图。比较他们卡片数差距的变化，并计入哈里增加的12张和威廉减少的24张。
