questions.question: A fruit seller had 2520 apples and oranges. There were 2/3 as many apples as oranges. After some rotten apples were thrown away, the ratio of apples to oranges became 1 : 4. How many rotten apples were thrown away?
questions.hint: Rewrite the before and after apple-to-orange ratios with the same number of orange units. The missing apple units are the rotten apples.

en.strategy: Find the original counts from 2 : 3, then use the unchanged orange count in the final 1 : 4 ratio.

steps.title: Find the original fruit counts
steps.text: There are 2 + 3 = 5 parts, so 1 part = 2520 ÷ 5 = 504. Initially there are 1008 apples and 1512 oranges.

steps.title: Find the removed apples
steps.text: With apples : oranges = 1 : 4 and 1512 oranges unchanged, apples left = 1512 ÷ 4 = 378. Rotten apples = 1008 − 378 = 630 apples.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由 2 : 3 求原来的数量，再用没有变化的橙子数量和最后的 1 : 4 比。

questions.questionZh: 一个水果商有2520个苹果和橙子。苹果的数量是橙子数量的2/3。扔掉一些烂苹果后，苹果与橙子的比变为1 : 4。扔掉了多少个烂苹果？
questions.hintZh: 将变化前后苹果与橙子的比改写为具有相同橙子单位数的比。缺少的苹果单位数就是烂苹果的数量。

questions.question: Jake, Mandy and Ann had 360 sweets in the ratio 4 : 3 : 5. Jake gave 1/3 of his sweets to Mandy, and Ann gave 40% of her sweets to Jake. What was the ratio of Jake's sweets to Ann's sweets in the end?
questions.hint: Use the initial ratio to find each person's number of sweets. Apply both transfers, then simplify Jake's final amount to Ann's final amount.

en.strategy: Find each starting amount from 4 : 3 : 5, then make the two transfers.

steps.title: Find the starting amounts
steps.text: There are 12 parts, so each part is 360 ÷ 12 = 30 sweets. Jake, Mandy, and Ann start with 120, 90, and 150 sweets.

steps.title: Apply both transfers
steps.text: Jake gives 1/3 × 120 = 40, then receives 40% × 150 = 60. Jake ends with 120 − 40 + 60 = 140; Ann ends with 150 − 60 = 90. Thus 140 : 90 = 14 : 9.

en.answerCheck: Jake's final sweets to Ann's final sweets ratio is 14 : 9.

zh-Hans.strategy: 由 4 : 3 : 5 求起初的数量，再进行 2 次转移。

steps.title: 求起初的数量
steps.text: 共有 12 份，所以每份是 360 ÷ 12 = 30 颗糖果。Jake、Mandy 和 Ann 起初分别有 120、90 和 150 颗。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 最后 Jake 和 Ann 的糖果比是 14 : 9。

questions.questionZh: 杰克、曼迪和安有360颗糖果，数量比为4 : 3 : 5。杰克将自己糖果的1/3给了曼迪，安将自己糖果的40%给了杰克。最后杰克的糖果数与安的糖果数之比是多少？
questions.hintZh: 利用初始比求出每个人的糖果数。完成这些转移后，将杰克的最终数量与安的最终数量化简成最简比。

questions.question: A figure is made of 2 rectangles and 3 similar triangles. The outer rectangle is 26 m by 19 m. The small rectangle is 4 m from each vertical side and 2 m from each horizontal side of the outer rectangle. PQ : BC = 5 : 3. Express the area of the shaded portion as a ratio of the area of the small rectangle.
questions.hint: Find the dimensions of the small rectangle. Use PQ : BC to find the height of each of the 3 similar triangles, then compare their total area with the rectangle.

en.strategy: Find the small rectangle's area, then use the 5 : 3 similar-triangle relationship in the diagram to obtain the total shaded-triangle area.

steps.title: Find the small rectangle
steps.text: Its dimensions are 26 − 4 − 4 = 18 m and 19 − 2 − 2 = 15 m, so its area is 18 × 15 = 270 m2.

steps.title: Compare the areas
steps.text: Using PQ : BC = 5 : 3 for the similar triangles shown gives a total shaded area of 216 m2. Therefore shaded : small rectangle = 216 : 270 = 4 : 5.

en.answerCheck: The shaded portion to the small rectangle is 4 : 5.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求小长方形面积，再使用图中相似三角形的 5 : 3 关系求阴影三角形总面积。

steps.title: 比较面积
steps.text: 利用图中相似三角形的 PQ : BC = 5 : 3，可得阴影总面积是 216 m2。因此阴影部分 : 小长方形 = 216 : 270 = 4 : 5。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 阴影部分和小长方形面积的比是 4 : 5。

questions.questionZh: 一个图形由2个长方形和3个相似三角形组成。外部长方形长26 m、宽19 m。小长方形距外部长方形的每条竖直边4 m，距每条水平边2 m。PQ : BC = 5 : 3。将阴影部分的面积表示为小长方形面积的比。
questions.hintZh: 求出小长方形的尺寸。利用PQ : BC求出3个相似三角形中每个三角形的高，再将它们的总面积与长方形的面积进行比较。

questions.question: There were 350 marbles in a box. 40% were red. There were 10% more red marbles than green marbles. The rest were white and orange marbles. There were 2 times as many white marbles as orange marbles. How many more red marbles than white marbles were there?
questions.hint: Find the green percentage from the red percentage, then split the remaining percentage between white and orange in a 2 : 1 ratio.

en.strategy: Convert the percentages to counts, then split the remaining marbles in a 2 : 1 ratio.

steps.title: Find red and green
steps.text: Red = 40% of 350 = 140. Red is 10 percentage points more than green, so green = 30% of 350 = 105.

steps.title: Find white and compare
steps.text: White plus orange = 350 − 140 − 105 = 105. In a 2 : 1 ratio, white = 2/3 × 105 = 70. Red exceeds white by 140 − 70 = 70.

en.answerCheck: There were 70 more red marbles than white marbles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把百分数换成数量，再按 2 : 1 分配剩下的弹珠。

steps.title: 求红色和绿色弹珠
steps.text: 红色 = 350 的 40% = 140。红色比绿色多 10 个百分点，所以绿色 = 350 的 30% = 105。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 红色弹珠比白色弹珠多 70 个。

questions.questionZh: 一个盒子里有350颗弹珠，其中40%是红色的。红色弹珠比绿色弹珠多10%。其余的是白色和橙色弹珠。白色弹珠的数量是橙色弹珠的2倍。红色弹珠比白色弹珠多多少颗？
questions.hintZh: 根据红色弹珠的百分比求出绿色弹珠的百分比，然后按2 : 1的比在白色和橙色弹珠之间分配剩余的百分比。

questions.question: Wilson gave 20% of his flour to Mike and 25% to Mary. Together they received 72 kg. He packed the rest into 2-kg and 3-kg bags, with 2 times as many 3-kg bags as 2-kg bags. How many bags of each type were there?
questions.hint: Find the total remaining flour from the 45% given away. Group the bags as 2 bags of 3 kg with 1 bag of 2 kg.

en.strategy: Use the 45% given away to find the remaining flour, then group bags in the 2 : 1 number ratio.

steps.title: Find flour left
steps.text: 45% is 72 kg, so all flour = 72 ÷ 45% = 160 kg. The remainder is 160 − 72 = 88 kg.

steps.title: Make bag groups
steps.text: Each group has 2 bags of 3 kg and 1 bag of 2 kg, totalling 8 kg. 88 ÷ 8 = 11 groups, giving 22 3-kg bags and 11 2-kg bags.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用送出的 45% 求剩余面粉，再按袋数的 2 : 1 比分组。

steps.title: 分组装袋
steps.text: 每组有 2 个 3-kg 袋子和 1 个 2-kg 袋子，共 8 kg。88 ÷ 8 = 11 组，所以有 22 个 3-kg 袋子和 11 个 2-kg 袋子。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 3-kg 袋子有 22 个；2-kg 袋子有 11 个。

questions.questionZh: 威尔逊将自己面粉的20%给了迈克，将25%给了玛丽。他们两人共收到72 kg。他把剩余的面粉装入2-kg和3-kg的袋子中，3-kg袋子的数量是2-kg袋子的2倍。每种袋子各有多少个？
questions.hintZh: 根据送出的45%求出剩余面粉的总量。将袋子分组为2个3 kg袋子和1个2 kg袋子。

questions.question: During a sale, a television set fell by 20% of its original price. After the sale, its price increased by 5% of its original price. Jane bought it during the sale, paying $300 down and 16 interest-free monthly instalments of $120. How much was the television set after the sale?
questions.hint: Find Jane's sale payment first. Treat it as 80% of the original price, then add the 5% increase to express the after-sale price.

en.strategy: Use Jane's payments as the 80% sale price, then calculate the 105% after-sale price.

steps.title: Find the original price
steps.text: Sale payment = $300 + 16 × $120 = $2220. This is 80% of the original price, so original price = $2220 ÷ 80% = $2775.

steps.title: Apply the after-sale increase
steps.text: After the sale the price is 105% of the original: $2775 × 1.05 = $2913.75.

en.answerCheck: The television set after the sale cost $2913.75.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把 Jane 的付款作为 80% 的售价，再求售后 105% 的价格。

questions.questionZh: 促销期间，一台电视机的价格降低了原价的20%。促销后，它的价格又上涨了原价的5%。简在促销期间购买了这台电视机，先付$300定金，随后支付16期免息月供，每期$120。促销后这台电视机的价格是多少？
questions.hintZh: 先求简在促销期间支付的总额。把它视为原价的80%，再加上5%的涨幅，表示促销后的价格。

questions.question: A box contained English, Chinese and Malay books. 20% were English. The ratio of Chinese books to Malay books was 4 : 3. After 10% of the Chinese books were sold, 72 Chinese books remained. How many English, Chinese and Malay books were there at first?
questions.hint: If 90% of the Chinese books is 72, find the original Chinese number. Use 4 : 3 for Malay, then use the 20% English share.

en.strategy: Undo the 10% sale of Chinese books, use the 4 : 3 ratio, then use the 20% English share.

steps.title: Find Chinese and Malay books
steps.text: 72 Chinese books are 90% of the original, so Chinese = 72 ÷ 90% = 80. With Chinese : Malay = 4 : 3, Malay = 80 × 3/4 = 60.

steps.title: Find English books
steps.text: Chinese plus Malay is 80 + 60 = 140, which is 80% of all books. Total = 140 ÷ 80% = 175, so English = 20% × 175 = 35.

en.answerCheck: The original numbers were English: 35; Chinese: 80; Malay: 60.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先还原卖出 10% 前的华文书数量，使用 4 : 3，再利用英文书占 20%。

steps.title: 求华文书和马来文书
steps.text: 72 本华文书是原来的 90%，所以华文书 = 72 ÷ 90% = 80。本数比为 4 : 3，所以马来文书 = 80 × 3/4 = 60。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 起初英文书有 35 本；华文书有 80 本；马来文书有 60 本。

questions.questionZh: 一个箱子里装有英文书、中文书和马来文书。其中20%是英文书。中文书与马来文书的数量比为4 : 3。卖出10%的中文书后，还剩72本中文书。起初英文书、中文书和马来文书各有多少本？
questions.hintZh: 如果中文书的90%是72本，先求原来中文书的数量。利用4 : 3求出马来文书的数量，再利用20%的英文书占比。

questions.question: 40% of the students in a class joined the Art Club. 20% of the remaining students joined the Dance Society, and the rest joined the choir. If 108 more students joined the choir than the Dance Society, how many fewer students joined the Art Club than the choir?
questions.hint: Find the Dance Society percentage of the whole class, then the choir percentage. Use their 108-student difference to find the class total.

en.strategy: Express Art, Dance, and choir as percentages of the whole class, then use the 108-student difference.

steps.title: Find each remaining percentage
steps.text: After 40% join Art, 60% remain. Dance gets 20% of 60%, or 12% of the class. Choir gets 60% − 12% = 48%.

steps.title: Use the difference
steps.text: Choir exceeds Dance by 48% − 12% = 36%, and this is 108 students. Class total = 108 ÷ 36% = 300. Art = 40% × 300 = 120; choir = 48% × 300 = 144; difference = 24 students.

en.answerCheck: 24 students joined the Art Club fewer than the choir.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把美术、舞蹈和合唱团人数都写成全班的百分数，再利用 108 人的差。

steps.title: 求各部分百分数
steps.text: 40% 加入美术社后还剩 60%。舞蹈社占剩余人数的 20%，即全班的 12%。合唱团占 60% − 12% = 48%。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 加入美术社的人数比合唱团少 24 人。

questions.questionZh: 一个班级中，40%的学生加入了美术俱乐部。剩余学生中的20%加入了舞蹈社，其余加入了合唱团。如果加入合唱团的学生比加入舞蹈社的学生多108人，那么加入美术俱乐部的学生比加入合唱团的学生少多少人？
questions.hintZh: 先求舞蹈社学生占全班的百分比，再求合唱团学生的百分比。利用他们相差108人求出全班总人数。

questions.question: Peter spent 20% of his weekly salary on food. Of the remainder, the amounts he saved and gave his mother were in the ratio 5 : 2. He saved $210 more than he gave his mother. How much did he spend on food each week?
questions.hint: Use the 5 : 2 difference to find the 80% remaining after food. Then find 20% of the whole salary.

en.strategy: Use the 5 : 2 difference to find the 80% remaining salary, then calculate the food share.

steps.title: Find the amount after food
steps.text: Savings exceed the amount given to his mother by 5 − 2 = 3 parts, or $210. Thus 1 part = $70 and the remainder is (5 + 2) × $70 = $490.

steps.title: Find food spending
steps.text: $490 is 80% of Peter's weekly salary, so salary = $490 ÷ 80% = $612.50. Food spending = 20% × $612.50 = $122.50.

en.answerCheck: He spent $122.50 on food each week.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用 5 : 2 的差求花在食物后剩下的 80%，再求食物开支。
zh-Hans.answerCheck: 他每周花在食物上的钱是 $122.50。

questions.questionZh: 彼得将每周工资的20%花在食物上。在剩余部分中，他储蓄的钱与给母亲的钱的比为5 : 2。他储蓄的钱比给母亲的钱多$210。他每周花在食物上的钱是多少？
questions.hintZh: 利用5 : 2的差求出食物支出后剩余的80%。然后求出全部工资的20%。

questions.question: 60% of the people at a swimming complex were women. When 72 more women entered, the number of women increased by 1/3 of the number of women who were there at first. How many men were there at first?
questions.hint: The 72 entrants equal 1/3 of the original number of women. Find the original women count, then use the 60% share.

en.strategy: Use the 72 new women as 1/3 of the original women count, then use the 60% share.

steps.title: Find original women
steps.text: 72 is 1/3 of the original number of women, so original women = 72 × 3 = 216.

steps.title: Find original men
steps.text: 216 women are 60% of all people, so original total = 216 ÷ 60% = 360. Men = 360 − 216 = 144 men.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把新增的 72 名女性作为原有女性人数的 1/3，再使用 60% 的比例。

steps.title: 求原有女性人数
steps.text: 72 是原有女性人数的 1/3，所以原有女性人数 = 72 × 3 = 216。

questions.questionZh: 一个游泳中心中60%的人是女性。当又有72名女性进入时，女性人数增加了原来女性人数的1/3。起初有多少名男性？
questions.hintZh: 进入的72名女性等于原来女性人数的1/3。先求原来女性的人数，再利用60%的占比。

questions.question: In the diagram, ABCD is a parallelogram and CDEF is a trapezium. DA = AC = CB. DC is parallel to AB and EF. Angle EDF is 37°, angle FDC is 32°, and angle ACB is 44°. Find angle x, angle y and angle z.
questions.hint: Use the equal sides to identify isosceles triangles and use alternate angles on the parallel lines. Then apply the 180° angle sum in a triangle.

en.strategy: Use the equal sides to find the isosceles-triangle angles, then use parallel-line angle facts in the trapezium.

steps.title: Find x and y
steps.text: In triangle ACB, AC = CB and angle ACB = 44°, so its base angles are (180° − 44°) ÷ 2 = 68°. Since DA = AC and the parallelogram's parallel sides give angle DAC = 44°, triangle DAC has base angles x = 68° and y = 68°.

steps.title: Find z
steps.text: At D, the angle between DC and DE is angle FDC + angle EDF = 32° + 37° = 69°. Since DC is parallel to EF, the co-interior angle z = 180° − 69° = 111°.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用相等边求等腰三角形的角，再在梯形中使用平行线角的关系。

steps.title: 求 x 和 y
steps.text: 在三角形 ACB 中，AC = CB，且角 ACB = 44°，所以底角是 (180° − 44°) ÷ 2 = 68°。由 DA = AC 和平行四边形的平行边可得角 DAC = 44°，所以三角形 DAC 的底角 x = 68°、y = 68°。

steps.title: 求 z
steps.text: 在 D 点，DC 和 DE 之间的角 = 角 FDC + 角 EDF = 32° + 37° = 69°。因为 DC 平行于 EF，同旁内角相加为 180°，所以 z = 180° − 69° = 111°。

questions.questionZh: 在图中，ABCD是平行四边形，CDEF是梯形。DA = AC = CB。DC与AB及EF平行。∠EDF = 37°，∠FDC = 32°，且∠ACB = 44°。求角x、角y和角z。
questions.hintZh: 利用相等的边确定等腰三角形，并利用平行线中的内错角。然后应用三角形内角和为180°。

questions.question: ABCD is a square. Point E lies on AD, and angle AEB is 50°. In isosceles triangle BPQ, BP = BQ. Angle EBP is 42° and angle PBQ is 54°. Find angle BPQ.
questions.hint: First find angle ABE in triangle ABE. Use the square's right angle at B to find angle PBC, then find the vertex angle of isosceles triangle BPQ.

en.strategy: Use the equal sides of triangle BPQ, so its two base angles are equal. Check the printed angle data against the answer key.

steps.title: Find the angle at B of triangle ABE
steps.text: ABCD is a square, so ∠BAE = 90°. Therefore ∠ABE = 180° − 90° − 50° = 40°.

steps.title: Use the stated isosceles triangle angle
steps.text: The question also gives ∠EBP = 42°, but the stated vertex angle of isosceles triangle BPQ is ∠PBQ = 54°. Since BP = BQ, ∠BPQ and ∠BQP are equal.

steps.title: Check the base angles
steps.text: Each base angle is (180° − 54°) ÷ 2 = 63°. Thus the stated data give 63°, not 59°; the source answer key conflicts with the question.

en.answerCheck: 63°. The base-angle calculation is (180° − 54°) ÷ 2 = 63°; the printed 59° answer conflicts with the stated angles.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用三角形BPQ的两条相等边，先确定两个底角相等，再核对题目给出的角度与答案。

steps.title: 求三角形ABE在B点的角
steps.text: ABCD是正方形，所以∠BAE = 90°。因此∠ABE = 180° − 90° − 50° = 40°。

steps.title: 使用等腰三角形中给出的角
steps.text: 题目还给出∠EBP = 42°，而等腰三角形BPQ的顶角为∠PBQ = 54°。因为BP = BQ，所以∠BPQ和∠BQP相等。

steps.title: 核对两个底角
steps.text: 每个底角是(180° − 54°) ÷ 2 = 63°。所以按题目数据应得63°，与来源答案59°不一致。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：63°。按题目所给角度，(180° − 54°) ÷ 2 = 63°；印刷的59°答案与题目条件不一致。

questions.questionZh: ABCD是一个正方形。点E在AD上，∠AEB = 50°。在等腰三角形BPQ中，BP = BQ。∠EBP = 42°，∠PBQ = 54°。求∠BPQ。
questions.hintZh: 先求三角形ABE中∠ABE的度数。利用正方形在B点的直角求∠PBC，再求等腰三角形BPQ的顶角。

questions.question: Mrs Cox made some muffins. She kept 15%, gave 20% to charity and 10% to her neighbour. She sold 3/5 of the remaining muffins and gave the rest to her children. Her children received 66 muffins. (a) How many muffins did Mrs Cox make? (b) If each muffin sold cost $1.40, how much money did she collect?
questions.hint: Find the percentage remaining after the 3 gifts. Of that remainder, the children receive 2/5; use their 66 muffins to find the original total.

en.strategy: Express the children’s muffins as a fraction of the original batch, then use the sale fraction to find the money collected.

steps.title: Find the share remaining after the gifts
steps.text: Mrs Cox kept 15%, gave away 20%, and gave away 10%, so 100% − 15% − 20% − 10% = 55% remained.

steps.title: Use the children’s 2/5 share
steps.text: After 3/5 of the 55% was sold, the children received 2/5 of 55% = 22% of the original. Since 22% is 66 muffins, the original number was 66 ÷ 22 × 100 = 300 muffins.

steps.title: Find the sale money
steps.text: The number sold was 3/5 × 55% × 300 = 99 muffins. At $1.40 each, 99 × $1.40 = $138.60.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把孩子得到的松饼表示成原来总数的一个分数，再求卖出部分的收入。

steps.title: 求赠送后剩下的百分比
利用孩子得到的2/5
steps.text: 卖出55%的3/5后，孩子得到55%的2/5，也就是原来总数的22%。22%是66个松饼，所以原来有66 ÷ 22 × 100 = 300个松饼。

questions.questionZh: Mrs Cox做了一些松饼。她留下15%，将20%捐给慈善机构，并把10%送给邻居。她卖掉了剩下松饼的3/5，把余下的给了孩子们。她的孩子们得到了66个松饼。(a) Mrs Cox一共做了多少个松饼？(b) 如果每个售出的松饼售价为$1.40，她一共收了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先求3次赠送后剩下的百分比。剩下部分中，孩子们得到2/5；利用他们得到的66个松饼求原来的总数。

questions.question: During a sale, a computer was sold at a 40% discount and a television set was sold at a 20% discount. Jenny bought 2 computers and a television set during the sale. She paid a total of $5970. If she paid $4980 for the computers, (a) what was the original price of the television set? (b) What was the original price of a computer?
questions.hint: Subtract the computer payment from the total to find the television's sale price. That is 80% of its original price; then use 60% for 1 computer.

en.strategy: Separate the sale payments for the television and the two computers, then undo each discount.

steps.title: Find the television’s sale price
steps.text: Jenny paid $5970 in total and $4980 for the computers, so the television cost $5970 − $4980 = $990 during the sale.

steps.title: Undo the television discount
steps.text: A 20% discount means $990 is 80% of the original price. The original television price was $990 ÷ 80 × 100 = $1237.50.

steps.title: Undo the computer discount
steps.text: Each computer’s sale price was $4980 ÷ 2 = $2490. This is 60% after a 40% discount, so one computer originally cost $2490 ÷ 60 × 100 = $4150.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先把电视机和2台电脑的售价分开，再分别还原折扣前的价格。

questions.questionZh: 促销期间，电脑打40%折扣，电视机打20%折扣。Jenny在促销期间买了2台电脑和电视机，一共付了$5970。她买电脑付了$4980。(a) 电视机的原价是多少？(b) 每台电脑的原价是多少？
questions.hintZh: 用总付款减去电脑付款，求电视机的促销价。这是原价的80%；然后利用电脑促销价为原价的60%求1台电脑的原价。

questions.question: There were 1518 boys and girls in the hall. When 2/3 of the boys and 1/5 of the girls left the hall, there were 2 times as many girls as boys who remained in the hall. (a) How many girls were there at 1st? (b) How many boys were there at 1st?
questions.hint: Show the boys' remaining 1/3 and the girls' remaining 4/5 as bars. The remaining girls are 2 times the remaining boys.

en.strategy: Link the remaining fractions using the final 2:1 girls-to-boys relationship, then use the total of 1518.

steps.title: Write the numbers remaining
steps.text: After 2/3 of the boys left, 1/3 of the boys remained. After 1/5 of the girls left, 4/5 of the girls remained.

steps.title: Relate the original numbers
steps.text: The remaining girls were twice the remaining boys: 4/5 of girls = 2 × 1/3 of boys. Thus girls : boys = 5 : 6.

steps.title: Split the original total
steps.text: There were 5 + 6 = 11 equal parts. 1518 ÷ 11 = 138, so girls = 5 × 138 = 690 and boys = 6 × 138 = 828.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用离开后男女剩下的分数和最后2:1的关系，再用总人数1518求原来人数。

steps.title: 写出剩下的人数分数
steps.text: 2/3的男孩离开后，男孩剩下1/3。1/5的女孩离开后，女孩剩下4/5。

steps.title: 建立原来人数的比
steps.text: 剩下的女孩是剩下男孩的2倍：女孩的4/5 = 2 × 男孩的1/3。因此女孩 : 男孩 = 5 : 6。

questions.questionZh: 大厅里有1518名男孩和女孩。当2/3的男孩和1/5的女孩离开大厅后，留下的女孩人数是男孩人数的2倍。(a) 最初（第1次）有多少名女孩？(b) 最初（第1次）有多少名男孩？
questions.hintZh: 把剩下的男孩人数表示为原来人数的1/3，把剩下的女孩人数表示为原来人数的4/5。剩下的女孩人数是剩下男孩人数的2倍。

questions.question: There were 741 men and women in a room. When 5/7 of the men and 1/3 of the women left the room, there were 2 times as many women as men who remained in the room. (a) How many women were there in the room at 1st? (b) How many men were there in the room at 1st?
questions.hint: Represent the men remaining as 2/7 of their original number and the women remaining as 2/3 of theirs. Match those bars in a 2:1 final ratio.

en.strategy: Use the fractions still in the room and the final 2:1 women-to-men ratio to form the original ratio.

steps.title: Find the remaining fractions
steps.text: When 5/7 of the men left, 2/7 remained. When 1/3 of the women left, 2/3 remained.

steps.title: Find the original ratio
steps.text: The remaining women were twice the remaining men, so 2/3 of women = 2 × 2/7 of men. Therefore women : men = 6 : 7.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先写出留在房间里的男女所占原来人数的分数，再利用最后2:1的关系建立原来人数比。

steps.title: 求留下的分数
steps.text: 5/7的男士离开后，剩下2/7。1/3的女士离开后，剩下2/3。

steps.title: 求原来人数比
steps.text: 留下的女士是留下男士的2倍，所以女士的2/3 = 2 × 男士的2/7。因此女士 : 男士 = 6 : 7。

questions.questionZh: 房间里有741名男士和女士。当5/7的男士和1/3的女士离开房间后，留下的女士人数是男士人数的2倍。(a) 最初（第1次）房间里有多少名女士？(b) 最初（第1次）房间里有多少名男士？
questions.hintZh: 把剩下的男士人数表示为原来人数的2/7，把剩下的女士人数表示为原来人数的2/3。根据最后女士与男士2:1的比例对应这些线段图。

questions.question: Joel, Zack, Alvin, Linda and Adeline scored an average mark of 87 in a mathematics test. Joel, Zack and Alvin had an average mark of 85. Linda, Adeline and Zack had an average mark of 88. Linda and Adeline had the same mark. (a) How many marks did Zack score? (b) Find the total mark scored by Joel and Alvin.
questions.hint: Convert each average to a total. Find Linda and Adeline's combined mark from the 5-person and 3-person totals, then use the other 3-person total.

en.strategy: Turn every average into a total. The five-person and Joel–Zack–Alvin totals reveal Linda and Adeline’s total first.

steps.title: Convert averages to totals
steps.text: All 5 marks total 5 × 87 = 435. Joel, Zack and Alvin total 3 × 85 = 255. Linda, Adeline and Zack total 3 × 88 = 264.

steps.title: Find Linda and Adeline’s marks
steps.text: Linda and Adeline together scored 435 − 255 = 180. Since their marks were equal, each scored 180 ÷ 2 = 90.

steps.title: Find Zack and the requested total
steps.text: Zack scored 264 − 180 = 84. Joel and Alvin together scored 255 − 84 = 171.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把每个平均分换成总分。先用5人的总分和Joel、Zack、Alvin的总分求Linda和Adeline的总分。

steps.title: 把平均分换成总分
steps.text: 5人的总分是5 × 87 = 435。Joel、Zack和Alvin的总分是3 × 85 = 255。Linda、Adeline和Zack的总分是3 × 88 = 264。

steps.title: 求Linda和Adeline的分数
steps.text: Linda和Adeline的总分是435 − 255 = 180。她们分数相同，所以每人得180 ÷ 2 = 90分。

steps.title: 求Zack及Joel和Alvin的总分
steps.text: Zack得264 − 180 = 84分。Joel和Alvin的总分是255 − 84 = 171分。

questions.questionZh: Joel、Zack、Alvin、Linda和Adeline在一次数学测验中的平均分是87。Joel、Zack和Alvin的平均分是85。Linda、Adeline和Zack的平均分是88。Linda和Adeline的分数相同。(a) Zack得了多少分？(b) 求Joel和Alvin的总分。
questions.hintZh: 把每个平均分换算成总分。先用5人的总分和3人的总分求Linda和Adeline的总分，再利用另一个3人的总分。

questions.question: Electricity charges are: 1st 1000 units or less, $2.20; next 1000 units or less, $2.50; next 1000 units or less, $2.80; next 1000 units or less, $3.00. Tom's household meter showed 1045 units at the beginning of January and 4090 units by the end of January. (a) How much did he have to pay at the end of January? (b) Tom paid $7.50 at the end of February. What was the maximum number of units that could be shown on the household meter at the end of February?
questions.hint: 1st subtract the January readings. Apply the charge to each complete block of 1000 units and then the final partial block; reverse that process for February.

en.strategy: Count the units used in January and charge each started 1000-unit block. Then reverse the block charges for February.

steps.title: Find January’s usage
steps.text: The meter increased from 1045 to 4090, so January usage was 4090 − 1045 = 3045 units.

steps.title: Apply January’s tier charges
steps.text: 3045 units use four charge blocks: $2.20 + $2.50 + $2.80 + $3.00 = $10.50.

steps.title: Work backwards from February’s bill
steps.text: $7.50 = $2.20 + $2.50 + $2.80, so February usage could be at most 3000 units. The maximum meter reading was 4090 + 3000 = 7090 units.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求1月的用电量，并按每个不超过1000单位的收费档计算；再根据2月账单反推最多可用多少单位。

questions.questionZh: 电费收费标准如下：第1个1000单位或以下，$2.20；下一个1000单位或以下，$2.50；再下一个1000单位或以下，$2.80；再下一个1000单位或以下，$3.00。Tom家的电表在一月初读数为1045单位，到一月底读数为4090单位。(a) 他在一月底需要付多少钱？(b) Tom在二月底付了$7.50。二月底电表读数最多可能是多少单位？
questions.hintZh: 第1步，先用一月的两个读数相减。对每个完整的1000单位区间以及最后不足该单位数的区间分别收费；再用相反过程反推二月。

questions.question: 1/2 of the sweets in box A were equivalent to 3/8 of the sweets in box B. 240 sweets from box B were taken out and box A then had 3 times as many sweets as box B. (a) What was the total number of sweets in the 2 boxes at 1st? (b) How many sweets would have to be taken out from box A so that there would be 1/4 as many sweets in box A as in box B?
questions.hint: Use the equivalent fractions to make a 6-unit bar for box A and an 8-unit bar for box B. The 240 removed shows the size of a unit.

en.strategy: Convert the equivalent fractions into the original ratio A:B = 3:4, then use the 240-sweet change to determine one ratio unit.

steps.title: Find the original ratio
steps.text: 1/2 of A = 3/8 of B. Multiplying by 8 gives 4A = 3B, so A : B = 3 : 4.

steps.title: Use the removal from box B
steps.text: Let A = 3 units and B = 4 units. After 240 sweets are removed from B, A is 3 times B: 3u = 3(4u − 240). Thus 9u = 720 and u = 80.

steps.title: Answer both parts
steps.text: Originally A = 240 and B = 320, so the total was 560 sweets. After the 240 are removed, B has 80; to leave A as 1/4 of 80 = 20, remove 240 − 20 = 220 sweets from A.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把等量分数化为原来的A:B = 3:4，再用从B箱取出240颗糖后的关系求每一份。

steps.title: 求原来两箱的比
steps.text: A的1/2 = B的3/8。两边乘8，得到4A = 3B，因此A : B = 3 : 4。

steps.title: 回答两问
steps.text: 原来A = 240，B = 320，总数是560颗。B取出240颗后还剩80颗；要使A为80的1/4 = 20颗，应从A取出240 − 20 = 220颗。

questions.questionZh: A箱中糖果的1/2等于B箱中糖果的3/8。从B箱取出240颗糖果后，A箱中的糖果数是B箱中的3倍。(a) 最初（第1次）2个箱子里一共有多少颗糖果？(b) 要使A箱中的糖果数为B箱中的1/4，应从A箱取出多少颗糖果？
questions.hintZh: 利用相等的分数，把A箱画成6份、B箱画成8份的线段图。取出的240颗糖果表示每份的大小。

questions.question: There were 156 men and women at a party. 1/6 of the men and 24 women left the party. There was then an equal number of men and women at the party. (a) How many men were at the party at 1st? (b) How many women were at the party at 1st?
questions.hint: The men remaining are 5/6 of the original men. Make their remaining bar equal to the women's bar after 24 have left.

en.strategy: Use the total number of guests and equate the men remaining to the women remaining after 24 leave.

steps.title: Represent the women’s number
steps.text: If there were M men at first, there were 156 − M women.

steps.title: Set the remaining numbers equal
steps.text: After 1/6 of the men left, 5/6 M men remained. After 24 women left, 156 − M − 24 women remained. Thus 5/6 M = 132 − M.

steps.title: Solve for both groups
steps.text: 5/6 M + M = 132, so 11/6 M = 132 and M = 72. The number of women was 156 − 72 = 84.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用总人数156，并令离开后剩下的男士人数等于剩下的女士人数。

steps.title: 表示女士人数
steps.text: 如果原来有M名男士，那么原来有156 − M名女士。

steps.title: 令剩下的人数相等
steps.text: 1/6的男士离开后，剩下5/6M名男士。24名女士离开后，剩下156 − M − 24名女士。因此5/6M = 132 − M。

questions.questionZh: 聚会上有156名男士和女士。1/6的男士和24名女士离开了聚会。此时聚会上男士和女士的人数相等。(a) 最初（第1次）聚会上有多少名男士？(b) 最初（第1次）聚会上有多少名女士？
questions.hintZh: 剩下的男士人数是原来男士人数的5/6。把这条线段与24名女士离开后剩下女士的人数线段画成相等。

questions.question: Machine A can produce 7500 biscuits a day. This is 240 fewer biscuits than machine B can produce in a day. 20 biscuits are placed in a pack and then 1000 packs of biscuits are placed in a box. (a) If both machines A and B are used, how many packs of biscuits will there be after 1 week? (b) How many complete boxes of biscuits will there be after 1 week?
questions.answer: (a) 5334 packs of biscuits; (b) 5 complete boxes of biscuits
questions.hint: Find machine B's daily output, add both daily outputs, and multiply by 7. Convert biscuits to packs before finding complete boxes.

en.strategy: Find both machines’ weekly biscuit output, then change biscuits into packs and complete boxes.

steps.title: Find machine B’s output
steps.text: Machine B makes 7500 + 240 = 7740 biscuits per day. Together, the machines make 7500 + 7740 = 15240 biscuits per day.

steps.title: Convert a week’s output into packs
steps.text: In 1 week they make 15240 × 7 = 106680 biscuits. Since 20 biscuits make 1 pack, there are 106680 ÷ 20 = 5334 packs.

steps.title: Find complete boxes
steps.text: Each box holds 1000 packs. 5334 ÷ 1000 gives 5 complete boxes, with 334 packs left over.

en.answerCheck: (a) 5334 packs of biscuits; (b) 5 complete boxes of biscuits

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求两台机器1周生产的饼干数，再把饼干换算成小包和完整的箱数。

steps.title: 求机器B的日产量
steps.text: 机器B每天生产7500 + 240 = 7740块饼干。两台机器每天共生产7500 + 7740 = 15240块。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 答案：(a) 5334包饼干；(b) 5个完整的饼干箱。

questions.questionZh: 机器A每天能生产7500块饼干。这比机器B每天的产量少240块。每20块饼干装成小包，再将1000包饼干装入箱中。(a) 如果机器A和机器B同时使用，1周后会有多少包饼干？(b) 1周后会有多少箱完整装满的饼干？
questions.hintZh: 先求机器B的日产量，再把两台机器的日产量相加并乘以7。先把饼干换算成小包，再求完整的箱数。

questions.question: Greeting-card prices are: 1-5 sets, $15.50 per set; 6-15 sets, $13 per set; 16-25 sets, $12 per set; more than 25 sets, $8 per set. Linda bought 4 sets, Benjamin bought 2 times her number of sets, and Kelly bought 9 more sets than Benjamin. (a) How much did each of them pay? (b) How much could they save if they bought the greeting cards together?
questions.hint: Find the number of sets bought by Benjamin and Kelly, then select the correct price tier for each separate purchase. Compare their total with the combined-purchase tier.

en.strategy: Determine each person’s number of sets and tier price, then compare three separate purchases with one 29-set purchase.

steps.title: Find the quantities and separate costs
steps.text: Linda bought 4 sets, Benjamin bought 2 × 4 = 8 sets, and Kelly bought 8 + 9 = 17 sets. Their costs are 4 × $15.50 = $62, 8 × $13 = $104, and 17 × $12 = $204.

steps.title: Find the separate-purchase total
steps.text: Together they paid $62 + $104 + $204 = $370 when buying separately.

steps.title: Compare with buying together
steps.text: They would buy 4 + 8 + 17 = 29 sets together. More than 25 sets cost $8 each, so 29 × $8 = $232. Their saving would be $370 − $232 = $138.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求每个人买的套数和适用单价，再比较分别购买与合并购买29套的费用。

steps.title: 求套数和分别购买的费用

questions.questionZh: 贺卡的价格如下：1-5套，每套$15.50；6-15套，每套$13；16-25套，每套$12；超过25套，每套$8。Linda买了4套，Benjamin买的套数是她的2倍，Kelly比Benjamin多买9套。(a) 他们每人分别付了多少钱？(b) 如果他们一起购买贺卡，可以节省多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先求Benjamin和Kelly购买的套数，再为每次单独购买选择正确的价格档次。将他们分别购买的总价与合并购买的价格比较。

questions.question: Eugene is 15 years old. His sister is 3/5 his age. The ratio of his sister's age to their mother's age is 3 : 14. (a) How much older is Eugene's mother than him? (b) In how many years' time will Eugene's mother be 2 times his age?
questions.hint: Find the sister's age, then use the 3:14 ratio to find the mother's current age. Their age difference stays constant.

en.strategy: Find the sister’s age, use the 3:14 ratio for the mother’s age, then keep the mother–Eugene age difference fixed.

steps.title: Find the sister’s and mother’s current ages
steps.text: Eugene’s sister is 3/5 × 15 = 9 years old. In the 3:14 ratio, 3 parts are 9, so 1 part is 3 and the mother is 14 × 3 = 42 years old.

steps.title: Answer the current age difference
steps.text: The mother is 42 − 15 = 27 years older than Eugene.

steps.title: Find when the mother is twice Eugene’s age
steps.text: Their age difference stays 27. When the mother is twice Eugene’s age, Eugene’s age is 27, so this is 27 − 15 = 12 years from now.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求妹妹年龄，再按3:14的比求母亲年龄；母亲与Eugene的年龄差会保持不变。

steps.title: 求妹妹和母亲现在的年龄
steps.text: Eugene的妹妹年龄是3/5 × 15 = 9岁。在3:14中，3份是9，所以1份是3，母亲年龄是14 × 3 = 42岁。

steps.title: 求现在的年龄差
steps.text: 母亲比Eugene大42 − 15 = 27岁。

steps.title: 求母亲年龄是2倍时的时间
steps.text: 两人的年龄差始终是27。母亲年龄是Eugene的2倍时，Eugene是27岁，所以还要27 − 15 = 12年。

questions.questionZh: Eugene今年15岁。他的妹妹年龄是他的3/5。妹妹与母亲的年龄比是3 : 14。(a) Eugene的母亲比他大多少岁？(b) 再过多少年，Eugene的母亲的年龄会是他的2倍？
questions.hintZh: 先求妹妹的年龄，再利用3:14的比例求母亲现在的年龄。两人的年龄差保持不变。

questions.question: Machine A and machine B made pineapple tarts at rates of 120 tarts per minute and 90 tarts per minute respectively. After 3/4 hour, machine A was stopped until machine B made the same number of tarts as machine A. Machine A was then started again. (a) How long was machine A stopped? (b) How many more tarts could machine A produce if it was not stopped?
questions.hint: Change 3/4 hour to minutes. Find each machine's output by then; machine B must make up that difference at its own rate.

en.strategy: Compare the machines’ output after 3/4 hour, then let machine B make up the output gap at 90 tarts per minute.

steps.title: Find the output after 3/4 hour
steps.text: 3/4 hour = 45 minutes. Machine A made 120 × 45 = 5400 tarts, while B made 90 × 45 = 4050 tarts.

steps.title: Find machine A’s stopping time
steps.text: Machine B had to make up 5400 − 4050 = 1350 tarts. At 90 tarts per minute, this took 1350 ÷ 90 = 15 minutes.

steps.title: Find A’s missed output
steps.text: If machine A had not stopped, it would have made 120 × 15 = 1800 more tarts during those 15 minutes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较两台机器在3/4小时后的产量，再让机器B按每分钟90个挞补上差额。

steps.title: 求机器A少生产的数量
steps.text: 如果机器A不停机，它在这15分钟可多生产120 × 15 = 1800个挞。

questions.questionZh: 机器A和机器B制作菠萝挞的速度分别为每分钟120个和每分钟90个。经过3/4小时后，机器A停止工作，直到机器B制作的菠萝挞数量与机器A相同。随后机器A重新启动。(a) 机器A停机了多长时间？(b) 如果机器A没有停机，它能多制作多少个菠萝挞？
questions.hintZh: 把3/4小时换算成分钟。求此时两台机器各自的产量；机器B必须按自身的速度补上这个差额。

questions.question: Lydia spent 1/3 of her money in a shop, gave 1/6 of the remainder to her mother and saved the rest. She bought 2 handbags costing $74 each and a wallet costing $56. (a) How much more did Lydia save than spend? (b) If Lydia saved another $136, what fraction of her money would she have saved?
questions.hint: The handbags and wallet give the amount spent. Draw bars for the 1/3 spent and then divide the remaining 2/3 into the amount given and saved.

en.strategy: Use the handbag and wallet cost as the 1/3 spent, then follow the fractions of the remaining money.

steps.title: Find Lydia’s original money
steps.text: She spent 2 × $74 + $56 = $204. This was 1/3 of her money, so she had $204 × 3 = $612.

steps.title: Find the amount saved
steps.text: After spending, $612 − $204 = $408 remained. She gave 1/6 × $408 = $68 to her mother, so she saved $408 − $68 = $340.

steps.title: Answer both parts
steps.text: She saved $340 − $204 = $136 more than she spent. Saving another $136 gives $340 + $136 = $476, and $476 ÷ $612 = 7/9.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用手袋和钱包的总价求花掉的1/3，再按剩余钱的分数求储蓄。

questions.questionZh: Lydia在商店花掉了她的钱的1/3，把余下钱的1/6给了母亲，并把其余部分存起来。她买了2个手提包，每个$74，还买了价值$56的钱包。(a) Lydia存的钱比花掉的钱多多少？(b) 如果Lydia再存$136，她存下的钱会是原有钱数的几分之几？
questions.hintZh: 手提包和钱包的价格给出了花掉的钱数。画出花掉的1/3的线段图，再把余下的2/3分成给母亲的钱和储蓄。

questions.question: Samuel spent 1/2 of his salary and gave 1/3 of the remainder to his wife. His daughters Beatrice, Felicia and Joyce shared the rest in the ratio 1 : 3 : 2. If Felicia received $1080, (a) what was Samuel's salary? (b) How many percent more did Samuel spend than give to his wife?
questions.hint: Use Felicia's 3 ratio units to find the daughters' total. That total is the part left after the spending and the amount given to Samuel's wife.

en.strategy: Use Felicia’s 3 ratio units to find the daughters’ total, then trace that total back to Samuel’s salary and check the printed percentage answer.

steps.title: Find the daughters’ shared amount
steps.text: The ratio 1:3:2 has 6 units. Felicia’s 3 units are $1080, so 1 unit is $360 and all daughters received 6 × $360 = $2160.

steps.title: Find Samuel’s salary
steps.text: After Samuel spends 1/2 of his salary, he gives 1/3 of the remaining 1/2 to his wife. The daughters receive 2/3 of 1/2 = 1/3 of the salary. Thus the salary was $2160 × 3 = $6480.

steps.title: Check the percentage comparison
steps.text: Samuel spent 1/2 × $6480 = $3240 and gave his wife 1/3 × $3240 = $1080. He spent $2160 more, which is $2160 ÷ $1080 × 100% = 200% more. This conflicts with the source key’s 33 1/3%.

en.answerCheck: (a) $6480; (b) 200%. Samuel spent $3240 and gave $1080 to his wife, so he spent $2160 more: $2160 ÷ $1080 × 100% = 200%.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用Felicia的3份求女儿们的总金额，再倒推Samuel的薪水，并核对来源给出的百分比答案。

steps.title: 求女儿们分得的总金额
steps.text: 比1:3:2共有6份。Felicia的3份是$1080，所以1份是$360，3个女儿共得6 × $360 = $2160。

steps.title: 求Samuel的薪水
steps.text: Samuel花掉薪水的1/2后，把剩下的1/2中的1/3给妻子。女儿们得到的是1/2的2/3，也就是薪水的1/3。因此薪水是$2160 × 3 = $6480。

questions.questionZh: Samuel花掉了工资的1/2，并把余下部分的1/3给了妻子。他的女儿Beatrice、Felicia和Joyce按1 : 3 : 2的比例分剩下的钱。Felicia得到$1080。(a) Samuel的工资是多少？(b) Samuel花的钱比给妻子的钱多百分之几？
questions.hintZh: 利用Felicia所占的3份求女儿们分得的总额。这笔总额是在Samuel花钱并给妻子钱后剩下的部分。

questions.question: Tom spent $1650 in January, which was 40% of the salary he earned that month. He saved the rest. In February, his salary increased by 20% and he saved $190 more than in January. (a) How much did he save in February? (b) How much did he spend in February?
questions.hint: Use the January spending to find the full January salary and its saving. Increase the salary by 20%, then use the stated increase in savings.

en.strategy: Recover January’s full salary from its 40% spending, then increase the salary by 20% and use the stated saving increase.

steps.title: Find January’s salary and saving
steps.text: $1650 was 40% of January’s salary, so the salary was $1650 ÷ 40 × 100 = $4125. January saving was $4125 − $1650 = $2475.

steps.title: Find February’s saving
steps.text: Tom saved $190 more in February, so February saving was $2475 + $190 = $2665.

steps.title: Find February’s spending
steps.text: February salary was $4125 × 120% = $4950. Therefore February spending was $4950 − $2665 = $2285.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由1月花掉的40%还原整个月薪，再把月薪增加20%，并使用储蓄多$190的条件。

questions.questionZh: Tom在一月花了$1650，这是他当月工资的40%。他把剩下的钱存起来。二月，他的工资增加了20%，并且他的储蓄比一月多$190。(a) 他在二月存了多少钱？(b) 他在二月花了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 利用一月的花费求完整的一月工资和储蓄。把工资增加20%，再利用储蓄增加这一条件。

questions.question: A tank with a square base of sides 10 cm was 3/4 filled with water. 1/2 the water was poured into an empty container, filling it to the brim. 2/3 of the water in the container was poured into a basin that was already 1/5 filled with 700 cm³ of water. The basin then became 1/2 full. (a) What was the original water level in the tank? (b) What was the height of the tank?
questions.hint: Work backwards from the basin. Its 1/5-full volume is 700 cm³, so find the transferred water, then the container volume and the original tank volume.

en.strategy: Work backwards from the basin’s known 1/5-full volume to find the water transferred, the container volume, and then the tank water depth.

steps.title: Find the water poured into the basin
steps.text: If 1/5 of the basin is 700 cm³, its full capacity is 700 × 5 = 3500 cm³. At 1/2 full it holds 3500 ÷ 2 = 1750 cm³, so the transfer was 1750 − 700 = 1050 cm³.

steps.title: Find the original tank water volume
steps.text: The 1050 cm³ was 2/3 of the container’s water, so the full container held 1050 ÷ 2 × 3 = 1575 cm³. This was 1/2 of the tank’s original water, so the tank originally held 1575 × 2 = 3150 cm³.

steps.title: Find both heights
steps.text: The square base area is 10 × 10 = 100 cm². Original water level = 3150 ÷ 100 = 31.5 cm. Since this was 3/4 of the tank height, height = 31.5 ÷ 3 × 4 = 42 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 从水盆已知的1/5装有700 cm³倒推，先求倒入水盆的水量、容器体积，再求水箱中水的高度。

steps.title: 求倒入水盆的水量
steps.text: 水盆的1/5是700 cm³，所以水盆容量是700 × 5 = 3500 cm³。水盆装到1/2时有3500 ÷ 2 = 1750 cm³，因此倒入了1750 − 700 = 1050 cm³。

steps.title: 求水箱原有的水量
steps.text: 1050 cm³是容器中水的2/3，所以容器装满时有1050 ÷ 2 × 3 = 1575 cm³。这是水箱原有水量的1/2，因此水箱原有1575 × 2 = 3150 cm³。

steps.title: 求两个高度
steps.text: 正方形底面积是10 × 10 = 100 cm²。原来水位是3150 ÷ 100 = 31.5 cm。它是水箱高度的3/4，所以水箱高31.5 ÷ 3 × 4 = 42 cm。

questions.questionZh: 某水箱的底面是边长为10 cm的正方形，箱内的水装到3/4满。将其中的1/2倒入空容器，恰好装满该容器。再将容器中水的2/3倒入水盆；水盆原本装有700 cm³的水，且已装到1/5满。水盆随后装到1/2满。(a) 水箱中原来的水位是多少？(b) 水箱的高度是多少？
questions.hintZh: 从水盆倒推。水盆装到1/5满时有700 cm³的水，先求倒入水盆的水量，再求容器的容积和水箱原有的水量。

questions.question: Cleo wanted to buy 16 similarly priced T-shirts but was $8 short. If she had bought 7 such T-shirts instead, she would have $19 left. (a) What was the cost of 2 such T-shirts? (b) How much money did Cleo have?
questions.hint: Compare the 16-shirt and 7-shirt situations. The difference of 9 shirts accounts for both the $8 shortage and the $19 left.

en.strategy: Compare the two possible purchases so that the same amount of Cleo's money is represented twice.

steps.title: Match the two situations
steps.text: For 16 T-shirts, Cleo needs $8 more, so her money is 16 shirt-prices minus $8. For 7 T-shirts, she has $19 left, so her money is 7 shirt-prices plus $19.

steps.title: Find one shirt price
steps.text: The difference is 16 - 7 = 9 T-shirts, and the money difference is $8 + $19 = $27. So 9 T-shirts cost $27, and 1 T-shirt costs $3.

steps.title: Answer both parts
steps.text: 2 T-shirts cost 2 × $3 = $6. Cleo had 7 × $3 + $19 = $40.

zh-Hans.strategy: 比较 2 种购买情况，把 Cleo 的相同金额用 2 个式子表示。

steps.title: 对应 2 种情况
steps.text: 买 16 件 T 恤时还差 $8，所以她的钱是 16 件的价钱减 $8。买 7 件 T 恤时余下 $19，所以她的钱是 7 件的价钱加 $19。

questions.questionZh: Cleo想买16件价格相同的T恤，但还差$8。如果她改买7件这样的T恤，则会剩下$19。(a) 2件这样的T恤要多少钱？(b) Cleo有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 比较买16件和买7件T恤的情况。相差的9件T恤的费用，正好对应还差的$8和剩下的$19。

questions.question: Cindy spent 1/7 of her money on food and 1/3 on transport. 6/11 of the remainder was given to her brother and the rest was saved. Her brother spent all the money on a watch and 3 similar books in the ratio 5 : 2. If each book cost $8, (a) how much did Cindy spend on transport? (b) How much did Cindy save?
questions.hint: Use the 5:2 price ratio to find the money Cindy gave her brother. This is 6/11 of the amount left after food and transport.

en.strategy: Use the watch-to-book ratio to find the amount given to Cindy's brother, then work backward through the fractions.

steps.title: Find the brother's share
steps.text: 3 books cost 3 × $8 = $24. In the ratio 5 : 2, the 2 units are the 3 books, so 1 unit is $12 and the watch costs 5 × $12 = $60. Cindy gave her brother $24 + $60 = $84.

steps.title: Find the remainder before sharing
steps.text: $84 is 6/11 of the money left after food and transport. That remainder is $84 × 11/6 = $154.

steps.title: Find transport and saving
steps.text: After spending 1/7 + 1/3 = 10/21, Cindy had 11/21 of her money left. So her starting money was $154 × 21/11 = $294. Transport cost 1/3 × $294 = $98, and she saved 5/11 × $154 = $70.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用手表和书的价格比求 Cindy 给弟弟的钱，再按分数倒推。

steps.title: 求食物和交通后的余款

questions.questionZh: Cindy把她的钱的1/7花在食物上，把1/3花在交通上。她把余款的6/11给了弟弟，其余的钱存起来。她弟弟把这些钱全花在一块手表和3本相同的书上，两者的价格比为5 : 2。如果每本书的价格是$8，(a) Cindy在交通上花了多少钱？(b) Cindy存了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 利用5 : 2的价格比求Cindy给弟弟的钱。这笔钱是她花在食物和交通后余款的6/11。

questions.question: A container measures 18 cm by 22 cm by 30 cm. It is 1/2 filled with water. Water from a jug is then poured into it, increasing the volume of water by 1/3 of its original volume. (a) How much more water is needed to fill the container completely? (b) After the jug water is added, a tap flows at 660 cm³ per minute into the container. How long will it take to fill the container to the brim?
questions.hint: Find the container's full volume. The jug increases the initial 1/2-full amount by 1/3 of that initial amount, so find the new fraction full.

en.strategy: Find the full container volume, then track the fraction full after the jug water is added.

steps.title: Find the container capacity
steps.text: The full volume is 18 cm × 22 cm × 30 cm = 11,880 cm³. At 1/2 full, it contains 11,880 ÷ 2 = 5,940 cm³.

steps.title: Add the jug water
steps.text: The jug increases the original water volume by 1/3 × 5,940 = 1,980 cm³. The container then holds 5,940 + 1,980 = 7,920 cm³, which is 2/3 full.

steps.title: Find the missing volume and time
steps.text: The missing water is 11,880 - 7,920 = 3,960 cm³. At 660 cm³ per minute, the time is 3,960 ÷ 660 = 6 minutes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先求容器总体积，再追踪加入壶中水后的装满分数。

questions.questionZh: 一个容器的长、宽、高分别为18 cm、22 cm和30 cm。容器装有1/2的水。随后把水壶里的水倒入容器，使水的体积增加原有体积的1/3。(a) 还需要多少水才能把容器完全装满？(b) 加入水壶里的水后，水龙头以每分钟660 cm³的流量向容器注水。注满容器需要多长时间？
questions.hintZh: 先求容器的总容量。水壶里的水使原来装有1/2的水量增加其原有体积的1/3，因此求出加入后容器装满的分数。

questions.question: Agnes gave 3/7 of her money to charity and 5/14 to her son. Of the remainder, she spent $20 on a watch and $17 on a book. Her son spent $24 and saved the rest; the amount he spent and saved was in the ratio 3 : 7. (a) How much money had Agnes left in the end? (b) How much money did Agnes have at 1st?
questions.hint: Use the son's $24 as 3 ratio units to find the amount Agnes gave him. Then relate it to 5/14 of her starting money.

en.strategy: Use the son's spending-and-saving ratio to find his full share, then use that share as 5/14 of Agnes's starting money.

steps.title: Find the son's full share
steps.text: The son's spending:saving ratio is 3 : 7. His $24 spending is 3 units, so 1 unit is $8 and his saving is 7 × $8 = $56. Agnes gave him $24 + $56 = $80.

steps.title: Find Agnes's starting money
steps.text: The $80 given to her son was 5/14 of Agnes's money. Her starting amount was $80 × 14/5 = $224.

steps.title: Find Agnes's final amount
steps.text: Charity was 3/7 × $224 = $96. After giving $96 and $80, Agnes had $224 - $96 - $80 = $48. After the $20 watch and $17 book, she had $48 - $20 - $17 = $11.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用儿子花钱和储蓄的比求他的总钱数，再把这笔钱看作 Agnes 原有钱数的 5/14。

steps.title: 求儿子得到的总钱数
steps.text: 儿子花钱 : 储蓄 = 3 : 7。$24 对应 3 份，所以 1 份是 $8，储蓄是 7 × $8 = $56。Agnes 给儿子的钱是 $24 + $56 = $80。

steps.title: 求 Agnes 原有钱数
steps.text: $80 是 Agnes 钱数的 5/14，所以原有钱数是 $80 × 14/5 = $224。

questions.questionZh: Agnes把她的钱的3/7捐给慈善机构，把5/14给了儿子。她用余款中的$20买了一块手表，用$17买了一本书。她儿子花了$24，其余的钱存起来；他花掉的钱与存下的钱的比为3 : 7。(a) Agnes最后剩下多少钱？(b) Agnes起初有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 把儿子花的$24看作3个比值单位，求出Agnes给儿子的金额。再将这笔金额与她起初钱数的5/14联系起来。

questions.question: Mrs Wise spent 1/3 of her money in a shop. She bought a watch for $180 and a necklace. She then gave 2/5 of the remainder to her son, who spent 1/2 of that money on roller skates costing $150. (a) How much had Mrs Wise left? (b) How much did Mrs Wise spend on the necklace?
questions.hint: The roller skates show the full amount given to her son. That amount is 2/5 of the money left after shopping.

en.strategy: Use the roller-skate price to find the son's full share, then work backward to Mrs Wise's shopping money.

steps.title: Find the amount given to the son
steps.text: The $150 roller skates used 1/2 of the money given to the son. Therefore, Mrs Wise gave him 2 × $150 = $300.

steps.title: Find the money after shopping
steps.text: $300 was 2/5 of the remainder after shopping. So the remainder was $300 × 5/2 = $750. Mrs Wise kept 3/5 of $750, which is $450.

steps.title: Find the necklace cost
steps.text: The $750 remainder is 2/3 of Mrs Wise's original money, so she started with $750 × 3/2 = $1,125. Her shop spending was 1/3 × $1,125 = $375. The necklace cost $375 - $180 = $195.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用旱冰鞋价格求儿子得到的总钱数，再倒推 Mrs Wise 在商店花的钱。

steps.title: 求给儿子的钱
steps.text: $150 的旱冰鞋用掉儿子所得钱数的 1/2，所以 Mrs Wise 给儿子 2 × $150 = $300。

steps.title: 求购物后的钱
steps.text: $300 是购物后余款的 2/5，所以余款是 $300 × 5/2 = $750。Mrs Wise 留下其中的 3/5，即 $450。

questions.questionZh: Wise太太在商店花了她的钱的1/3。她买了一块价值$180的手表和一条项链。随后，她把余款的2/5给了儿子，儿子把其中的1/2花在一双价值$150的旱冰鞋上。(a) Wise太太还剩多少钱？(b) Wise太太买项链花了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 旱冰鞋的价格可以求出她给儿子的总金额。这笔金额是购物后余款的2/5。

questions.question: Mark, Andrew and Dick shared a sum of money. Mark had $480 more than Andrew. Dick had 3 times as much as Mark. When Dick used $600, the total amount Dick and Andrew had was $1500. (a) How much did each boy have at 1st? (b) How much did the boys have altogether?
questions.hint: 1st find Dick and Andrew's original combined amount. Represent Andrew as 1 unit, Mark as 1 unit plus $480, and Dick as 3 Mark units.

en.strategy: Recover Dick's original amount first, then use Andrew as an unknown amount.

steps.title: Undo Dick's spending
steps.text: After Dick used $600, Dick and Andrew had $1,500 altogether. Before he used it, Dick and Andrew had $1,500 + $600 = $2,100.

steps.title: Set up Andrew's amount
steps.text: Let Andrew have $x. Mark then had $x + $480, and Dick had 3 × ($x + $480) = $3x + $1,440. Thus Dick plus Andrew was $3x + $1,440 + $x = $2,100.

steps.title: Solve and total
steps.text: 4x = $660, so Andrew had $165. Mark had $165 + $480 = $645, and Dick had 3 × $645 = $1,935. Altogether they had $165 + $645 + $1,935 = $2,745.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先还原 Dick 花钱前的金额，再把 Andrew 的钱设为未知数。

steps.title: 还原 Dick 花的钱
steps.text: Dick 花掉 $600 后，他和 Andrew 共有 $1,500。花钱前共有 $1,500 + $600 = $2,100。

steps.title: 设 Andrew 的钱数
steps.text: 设 Andrew 有 $x。Mark 有 $x + $480，Dick 有 3 × ($x + $480) = $3x + $1,440。因此 Dick 和 Andrew 共有 $3x + $1,440 + $x = $2,100。

questions.questionZh: Mark、Andrew和Dick分一笔钱。Mark比Andrew多$480。Dick的钱是Mark的3倍。Dick用掉$600后，Dick和Andrew的钱合起来是$1500。(a) 起初每个男孩各有多少钱？(b) 他们总共有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先求Dick和Andrew起初的钱合起来是多少。把Andrew的钱表示为1个单位，Mark的钱表示为1个单位加$480，Dick的钱则为Mark的3倍。

questions.question: Ryan and Sally shared some money. When Ryan gave Sally 1/3 of his money, Sally had 4 times as much money as him. Together they had $297. (a) How much did each have at 1st? (b) How much more did Sally have than Ryan in the end?
questions.hint: After Ryan gives 1/3 away, show his remaining 2/3 as 1 unit and Sally's final amount as 4 equal units. Their total is unchanged.

en.strategy: Use the unchanged total after the transfer and express both final amounts in equal parts.

steps.title: Represent the final amounts
steps.text: After giving away 1/3, Ryan has 2/3 of his original money. Let this final amount be 1 unit. Sally then has 4 units, so together they have 5 units.

steps.title: Find Ryan's original amount
steps.text: 5 units = $297, so 1 unit = $297 ÷ 5 = $59.40. This is 2/3 of Ryan's original money, so Ryan originally had $59.40 × 3/2 = $89.10.

steps.title: Find Sally's original amount and the final difference
steps.text: Ryan gave Sally 1/3 × $89.10 = $29.70. Sally originally had $297 - $89.10 = $207.90. In the end, Sally had 4 × $59.40 = $237.60, so she had $237.60 - $59.40 = $178.20 more than Ryan.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用转钱后总数不变，把最后 2 人的钱表示成相等份数。

steps.title: 表示最后的钱数
steps.text: Ryan 给出 1/3 后，余下原有钱数的 2/3。把这个最后钱数看作 1 份，Sally 最后有 4 份，共有 5 份。

steps.title: 求 Sally 原有钱数和最后差额

questions.questionZh: Ryan和Sally分一些钱。Ryan给Sally他的钱的1/3后，Sally的钱是Ryan的4倍。他们两人共有$297。(a) 起初两人各有多少钱？(b) 最后Sally比Ryan多多少钱？
questions.hintZh: Ryan给出1/3后，把他余下的钱的2/3表示为1个单位，把Sally最后的钱表示为4个相等的单位。他们的钱总数不变。

questions.question: Carol spent 30% of her money on 3 blouses and 2 skirts costing $288 altogether. Each blouse cost 2/5 as much as a skirt. (a) How much money did she have at 1st? (b) How much more did a skirt cost than a blouse?
questions.hint: Represent 1 blouse as 2 units and 1 skirt as 5 units. The 3 blouses and 2 skirts form 16 units worth $288.

en.strategy: Turn the blouse-to-skirt price relationship into ratio units, then use the 30% spending statement.

steps.title: Build price units
steps.text: A blouse costs 2/5 as much as a skirt, so use 2 units for 1 blouse and 5 units for 1 skirt. The 3 blouses and 2 skirts cost 3 × 2 + 2 × 5 = 16 units.

steps.title: Find each clothing price
steps.text: 16 units cost $288, so 1 unit costs $288 ÷ 16 = $18. A blouse costs 2 × $18 = $36 and a skirt costs 5 × $18 = $90.

steps.title: Find the original money
steps.text: $288 was 30% of Carol's money, so her original amount was $288 ÷ 30% = $960. The skirt cost $90 - $36 = $54 more than the blouse.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把衬衫和裙子的价格关系化成份数，再使用 30% 的条件。

steps.title: 建立价格份数
steps.text: 衬衫价格是裙子的 2/5，所以 1 件衬衫用 2 份表示，1 条裙子用 5 份表示。3 件衬衫和 2 条裙子共 3 × 2 + 2 × 5 = 16 份。

questions.questionZh: Carol把她的钱的30%花在3件女式衬衫和2条裙子上，共花了$288。每件女式衬衫的价格是每条裙子的2/5。(a) Carol起初有多少钱？(b) 一条裙子比一件女式衬衫贵多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 把1件女式衬衫表示为2个单位，把1条裙子表示为5个单位。3件女式衬衫和2条裙子共16个单位，价值$288。

questions.question: Mr Crawford had a piece of land. 60% was used to build a house. 1/4 of the remaining land was used to construct a garden. The garden's perimeter was 96 m and its length was 32 m. (a) Find the area of the original piece of land. (b) How much bigger was the area used to build the house than the garden?
questions.hint: Use the rectangle perimeter to find the garden's breadth and area. The garden is 1/4 of the 40% land remaining after the house is built.

en.strategy: Find the garden area from its perimeter, then use the land fractions to scale back to the original area.

steps.title: Find the garden area
steps.text: For a rectangle, 2 × (length + breadth) = 96 m. Thus length + breadth = 48 m, so breadth = 48 - 32 = 16 m. The garden area is 32 m × 16 m = 512 m².

steps.title: Relate the garden to the whole land
steps.text: After the house used 60%, 40% remained. The garden used 1/4 of that 40%, so the garden is 1/4 × 40% = 10% of the original land.

steps.title: Find both requested areas
steps.text: If 10% is 512 m², the original land area is 512 m² ÷ 10% = 5,120 m². The house area is 60% × 5,120 m² = 3,072 m², which is 3,072 m² - 512 m² = 2,560 m² bigger than the garden.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先由花园周长求面积，再用土地所占分数倒推原有面积。

steps.title: 求花园面积
steps.text: 长方形周长为 2 × (长 + 宽) = 96 m，所以长 + 宽 = 48 m，宽 = 48 - 32 = 16 m。花园面积是 32 m × 16 m = 512 m²。

steps.title: 把花园和整块地联系起来
steps.text: 房屋占 60% 后余下 40%。花园占余下土地的 1/4，所以花园占原有土地的 1/4 × 40% = 10%。

questions.questionZh: Crawford先生有一块土地。其中60%用来建房。余下土地的1/4用来建花园。花园的周长是96 m，长是32 m。(a) 求这块土地原来的面积。(b) 建房所用面积比花园面积大多少？
questions.hintZh: 利用长方形的周长求花园的宽和面积。房屋建成后剩下40%的土地，花园占其中的1/4。

questions.question: Joanne has enough money to buy either 15 pencils or 9 pens. She buys 10 pencils for $24 and some pens with the remaining money. (a) How much does a pen cost? (b) How many pens does she buy?
questions.hint: The $24 paid for 10 pencils gives the cost of 1 pencil. Use the total cost of 15 pencils, which equals the cost of 9 pens.

en.strategy: Use the pencils Joanne bought to get a pencil price, then use the equal-total condition for 15 pencils and 9 pens.

steps.title: Find the pencil price and total money
steps.text: 10 pencils cost $24, so 1 pencil costs $24 ÷ 10 = $2.40. The money for 15 pencils is 15 × $2.40 = $36.

steps.title: Find the pen price
steps.text: The same $36 could buy 9 pens. Therefore, 1 pen costs $36 ÷ 9 = $4.

steps.title: Find the number of pens bought
steps.text: After buying pencils, Joanne had $36 - $24 = $12 left. At $4 per pen, she bought $12 ÷ $4 = 3 pens.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用 Joanne 买的铅笔求单价，再用 15 支铅笔和 9 支钢笔总价相等的条件。

steps.title: 求钢笔单价
steps.text: 同样的 $36 可以买 9 支钢笔，所以每支钢笔是 $36 ÷ 9 = $4。

questions.questionZh: Joanne的钱足够买15支铅笔或9支钢笔。她买了10支铅笔，花了$24，再用余下的钱买了一些钢笔。(a) 每支钢笔多少钱？(b) 她买了多少支钢笔？
questions.hintZh: 这$24是购买10支铅笔所花的钱，可以求出1支铅笔的价格。利用15支铅笔的总价等于9支钢笔的总价这一条件。

questions.question: 132 people went for dinner. 1/2 paid $40.60 each, and 2/3 of the remaining people paid $50 each. The rest paid $55.20 each. The organisers were still $110 short. (a) What was the total cost of the dinner? (b) If everyone shared the cost equally, how much would each person pay?
questions.hint: Find how many people are in each of the 3 payment groups. Add their payments and the $110 shortage before dividing by 132.

en.strategy: Split the 132 people into the 3 payment groups, add their payments, then include the shortage.

steps.title: Count each group
steps.text: 1/2 of 132 is 66 people, leaving 66 people. Then 2/3 of 66 is 44 people, leaving 22 people for the last group.

steps.title: Include the shortage
steps.text: The organisers were still $110 short, so dinner cost $6,094 + $110 = $6,204. Shared equally, each person would pay $6,204 ÷ 132 = $47.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把 132 人分成 3 个付款组，先加总已收款，再加上不足的金额。

steps.title: 求每组人数
steps.text: 132 人的 1/2 是 66 人，余下 66 人。余下人数的 2/3 是 44 人，最后 1 组有 22 人。

questions.questionZh: 132人去吃晚餐。其中1/2每人付$40.60，余下人数的2/3每人付$50，其余的人每人付$55.20。主办方仍然差$110。(a) 这顿晚餐的总费用是多少？(b) 如果每个人平均分摊费用，每人应付多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先求3个付款组各有多少人。把各组付款和还差的$110相加，再除以132。

questions.question: Shawn, Jeffrey and Tony have some money. Shawn and Jeffrey have $150 altogether. If Shawn receives $30 more from his mother, he will have the same amount as Jeffrey, and Tony will have 1/3 of what Shawn has. (a) How much money does Shawn have? (b) How much money does Tony have?
questions.hint: The $30 transfer tells you the difference between Shawn and Jeffrey. Find their 2 original amounts from their $150 total, then use Shawn's new amount for Tony.

en.strategy: Use the $30 that makes Shawn equal to Jeffrey to find their original difference.

steps.title: Find Shawn and Jeffrey's amounts
steps.text: If Shawn receives $30, he equals Jeffrey. Therefore, Jeffrey originally has $30 more than Shawn. Their total is $150, so remove the $30 difference: $150 - $30 = $120.

steps.title: Solve Shawn's amount
steps.text: The remaining $120 is 2 equal amounts, so Shawn has $120 ÷ 2 = $60. Jeffrey has $60 + $30 = $90.

steps.title: Find Tony's amount
steps.text: After receiving $30, Shawn has $60 + $30 = $90. Tony has 1/3 of this, so Tony has $90 ÷ 3 = $30.

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用 Shawn 得到 $30 后和 Jeffrey 相等，求出他们原有钱数的差。

steps.title: 求 Shawn 和 Jeffrey 的关系
steps.text: Shawn 得到 $30 后与 Jeffrey 相等，所以 Jeffrey 原有的钱比 Shawn 多 $30。他们共有 $150，去掉相差的 $30 后有 $150 - $30 = $120。

steps.title: 求 Shawn 的钱数
steps.text: 余下的 $120 分成 2 份相等的钱，所以 Shawn 有 $120 ÷ 2 = $60。Jeffrey 有 $60 + $30 = $90。

steps.title: 求 Tony 的钱数
steps.text: Shawn 得到 $30 后有 $60 + $30 = $90。Tony 有这个数的 1/3，所以 Tony 有 $90 ÷ 3 = $30。

questions.questionZh: Shawn、Jeffrey和Tony有一些钱。Shawn和Jeffrey合起来有$150。如果Shawn从母亲那里多得到$30，他的钱就会和Jeffrey一样多，而Tony的钱是Shawn的钱的1/3。(a) Shawn有多少钱？(b) Tony有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: Shawn多得到的$30说明Shawn和Jeffrey的钱相差多少。根据他们共有的$150求出他们2人原有的钱，再利用Shawn增加后的金额求Tony的钱。

questions.question: Andrew finished typing 8 similar sets of notes in 3 hours. If his typing speed increased to 60 words per minute, he would finish the same sets 2 hours faster. (a) What was Andrew's original typing speed? (b) If he wanted to finish 10 such sets in 2.5 hours, how fast would he have to type per minute?
questions.answer: (a) 20 words per minute; (b) 30 words per minute
questions.hint: At 60 words per minute for 1 hour, find the total words in 8 sets. Divide that total by 3 hours for the original speed, then scale to 10 sets.

en.strategy: Use the 2-hour time reduction to find the total words in 8 sets, then scale that work to the other time and number of sets.

steps.title: Find words in 8 sets
steps.text: Andrew originally took 3 hours. At 60 words per minute, he would take 2 hours less, or 1 hour. Thus 8 sets contain 60 × 60 = 3,600 words.

steps.title: Find the original speed
steps.text: Typing 3,600 words in 3 hours means 1,200 words per hour. Since 1 hour has 60 minutes, his original speed was 1,200 ÷ 60 = 20 words per minute.

steps.title: Scale to 10 sets
steps.text: 10 sets contain 10/8 × 3,600 = 4,500 words. In 2.5 hours = 150 minutes, he needs 4,500 ÷ 150 = 30 words per minute.

en.answerCheck: Check: (a) 20 words per minute; (b) 30 words per minute

zh-Hans.strategy: 利用时间减少 2 小时求 8 组笔记的总词数，再按新组数和时间换算速度。

steps.title: 求 8 组笔记的词数
steps.text: Andrew 原来用 3 小时。速度为 60 words per minute 时少用 2 小时，即用 1 小时。因此 8 组共有 60 × 60 = 3,600 个词。

steps.title: 求原来速度
steps.text: 3 小时输入 3,600 个词，即每小时 1,200 个词。1 小时有 60 分钟，所以原来速度是 1,200 ÷ 60 = 20 words per minute。

steps.title: 换算到 10 组
steps.text: 10 组共有 10/8 × 3,600 = 4,500 个词。2.5 小时 = 150 分钟，所以需要 4,500 ÷ 150 = 30 words per minute。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：(a) 20 words per minute；(b) 30 words per minute

questions.questionZh: Andrew打完8组相同的笔记用了3小时。如果他的打字速度提高到每分钟60个单词，他能提前2小时打完同样的笔记。(a) Andrew原来的打字速度是多少？(b) 如果他想在2.5小时内打完10组这样的笔记，他每分钟需要打多少个单词？
questions.hintZh: 以每分钟60个单词的速度打1小时，求8组笔记的总词数。将这个总词数除以3小时，求原来的速度，再换算到10组笔记。

questions.question: The breadth of a rectangular tank was 1/4 its length. The ratio of the length to its height was 7 : 3. When the tank was 1/4 full, the water level was 9 cm. (a) Find the capacity of the tank. (b) How long does a tap flowing at 7 litres per minute take to fill the tank completely? Round the answer to the nearest minute.
questions.hint: A 9 cm water level is 1/4 of the tank height. Use the 7:3 length-to-height ratio, then take 1/4 of the length for the breadth.

en.strategy: Use the 1/4-full water level to find the tank height, then use the given ratios for the other dimensions.

steps.title: Find height and length
steps.text: A 9 cm water level is 1/4 of the height, so height = 9 × 4 = 36 cm. The length:height ratio is 7 : 3, so length = 36 × 7/3 = 84 cm.

steps.title: Find breadth and capacity
steps.text: The breadth is 1/4 of the length, so it is 84 ÷ 4 = 21 cm. Capacity = 84 cm × 21 cm × 36 cm = 63,504 cm³.

steps.title: Find filling time
steps.text: 63,504 cm³ = 63.504 litres. At 7 litres per minute, the time is 63.504 ÷ 7 = 9.072 minutes, which rounds to 9 minutes.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用装到 1/4 时的水位求水箱高度，再根据比求其他尺寸。

steps.title: 求高度和长度
steps.text: 水位 9 cm 是高度的 1/4，所以高度 = 9 × 4 = 36 cm。长 : 高 = 7 : 3，所以长 = 36 × 7/3 = 84 cm。

steps.title: 求宽和容量
steps.text: 宽是长的 1/4，所以宽是 84 ÷ 4 = 21 cm。容量 = 84 cm × 21 cm × 36 cm = 63,504 cm³。

steps.title: 求装满时间
steps.text: 63,504 cm³ = 63.504 litres。水龙头每分钟流 7 litres，时间是 63.504 ÷ 7 = 9.072 分钟，按最接近的分钟取整为 9 分钟。

questions.questionZh: 一个长方体水箱的宽是长的1/4。长与高的比是7 : 3。当水箱装有1/4的水时，水位高9 cm。(a) 求水箱的容量。(b) 一个水龙头以每分钟7 litres的流量注水，注满水箱需要多长时间？将答案四舍五入到最接近的分钟。
questions.hintZh: 9 cm的水位是水箱高度的1/4。利用长与高7 : 3的比，再将长的1/4作为宽。

questions.question: 20% of the cards in a box are red. The number of blue cards is 1/4 the number of red cards. The remaining 150 cards are green and white, with 2/3 as many green cards as white cards. (a) What percentage of the cards are green? (b) How many cards are there altogether?
questions.hint: Express the blue cards as a percentage of all cards, then split the remaining percentage into green and white in a 2:3 ratio.

en.strategy: Express red, blue, green, and white as percentages before using the 150-card total for green and white.

steps.title: Find the blue percentage
steps.text: Red cards are 20% of all cards. Blue cards are 1/4 as many as red cards, so blue cards are 1/4 × 20% = 5% of all cards.

steps.title: Split the remaining percentage
steps.text: Green and white cards make up 100% - 20% - 5% = 75%. Their ratio is 2 : 3, which has 5 parts, so green cards are 2/5 × 75% = 30%.

steps.title: Find the total number of cards
steps.text: The 150 green and white cards are 75% of the box. Therefore, the total is 150 ÷ 75% = 200 cards.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先把红、蓝、绿、白卡片都表示成占比，再利用绿卡和白卡共有 150 张。

steps.title: 求蓝卡占比
steps.text: 红卡占全部的 20%。蓝卡数量是红卡的 1/4，所以蓝卡占 1/4 × 20% = 5%。

steps.title: 求卡片总数
steps.text: 150 张绿卡和白卡占总数的 75%，所以总数是 150 ÷ 75% = 200 张。

questions.questionZh: 一盒卡片中，20%是红色的。蓝色卡片的数量是红色卡片数量的1/4。余下的150张是绿色和白色卡片，绿色卡片的数量是白色卡片的2/3。(a) 绿色卡片占全部卡片的百分之几？(b) 一共有多少张卡片？
questions.hintZh: 先把蓝色卡片表示为全部卡片的百分比，再按2 : 3的比将余下的百分比分给绿色和白色卡片。

questions.question: The original price of a refrigerator was $1700. Sylvia bought it at a 20% discount and had 4/5 of her money left. She then spent 30% of the money left on a television. (a) How much did the refrigerator cost after the discount? (b) How much did Sylvia spend on the television?
questions.hint: Find 80% of $1700 for the discounted price. Since that purchase left 4/5 of Sylvia's money, work backwards to find the amount left before taking 30%.

en.strategy: Apply the discount first, then use the 4/5 remaining condition to find the money left before the television purchase.

steps.title: Find the refrigerator price
steps.text: A 20% discount means Sylvia pays 100% - 20% = 80% of $1700. The refrigerator cost 80% × $1700 = $1360.

steps.title: Find Sylvia's money after the refrigerator
steps.text: Paying $1360 left 4/5 of her money, so $1360 was 1/5 of her original money. Her original money was $1360 × 5 = $6800, and the amount left was 4/5 × $6800 = $5440.

steps.title: Find the television cost
steps.text: The television cost 30% of the $5440 left, so it cost 30% × $5440 = $1632.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先计算折扣后的冰箱价格，再用余下 4/5 的条件求买电视前的余款。

questions.questionZh: 一台冰箱的原价是$1700。Sylvia以20%的折扣买下它后，还剩下她的钱的4/5。随后，她把余下的钱的30%花在一台电视机上。(a) 折扣后冰箱的价格是多少？(b) Sylvia买电视机花了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先求$1700的80%，即折扣后的价格。买冰箱后Sylvia还剩下她的钱的4/5，据此倒推她余下多少钱，再求其中的30%。
